<file path="apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx">
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AuthState {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  accessToken: string | null;
  tenantCode: string | null;
  permissions: string[];
}

interface AuthContextType extends AuthState {
  login: (token: string, tenant: string, perms: string[]) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  hasPermission: (permission: string) => boolean;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [authState, setAuthState] = useState<AuthState>({
    isAuthenticated: false,
    accessToken: null,
    tenantCode: null,
    permissions: [],
  });

  const login = (token: string, tenant: string, perms: string[]) => {
    // In a real app, securely store the token (e.g. secure HTTP-only cookies preferred, 
    // or memory + refresh token rotation)
    setAuthState({
      isAuthenticated: true,
      accessToken: token,
      tenantCode: tenant,
      permissions: perms,
    });
  };

  const logout = () => {
    setAuthState({
      isAuthenticated: false,
      accessToken: null,
      tenantCode: null,
      permissions: [],
    });
  };

  const hasPermission = (permission: string) => {
    return authState.permissions.includes(permission);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ ...authState, login, logout, hasPermission }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx">
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

export const LoginPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [tenantCode, setTenantCode] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      // Simulate API call to POST /api/v1/identity/auth/login
      console.log('Logging in with', { email, tenantCode });
      
      // Simulate successful response
      const mockToken = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...";
      login(mockToken, tenantCode, ['users.read', 'customs.read']);
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Invalid credentials or tenant code');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: '400px', margin: '100px auto', fontFamily: 'sans-serif' }}>
      <h2>Sign in to Smart Trade Platform</h2>
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'red' }}>{error}</p>}
      <form onSubmit={handleLogin} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '15px' }}>
        <div>
          <label>Tenant Code</label>
          <input 
            type="text" 
            value={tenantCode} 
            onChange={(e) => setTenantCode(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Email</label>
          <input 
            type="email" 
            value={email} 
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Password</label>
          <input 
            type="password" 
            value={password} 
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} 
            required 
            style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px' }}
          />
        </div>
        <button type="submit" style={{ padding: '10px', background: '#0056b3', color: 'white', border: 'none' }}>
          Sign In
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="docs/deployment/PRODUCTION-ARCHITECTURE.md">
# Production Architecture & Kubernetes Hardening

## 1. Environments & Namespaces
- `platform-dev`
- `platform-test`
- `platform-staging`
- `platform-performance`
- `platform-production`

## 2. Kubernetes Network Policies (Default DENY)
- **Ingress**: External traffic is ONLY permitted to the YARP API Gateway Pods.
- **Service-to-Service**: Gateway may route to domain services. Domain services may communicate with internal Redis, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ exclusively via explicitly allowed egress rules.
- **Public Exposure**: PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ are strictly isolated to internal cluster networking.

## 3. Pod Security Standards
All application pods enforce the **Restricted** profile:
- `runAsNonRoot: true`
- `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` (where possible)
- Drops all default Linux capabilities.

## 4. Autoscaling (HPA) & Disruption (PDB)
- **HPA**: Configured for Gateway, Control Tower BFF, and high-volume consumers (GPS/ANPR) based on Phase 15.7 load test targets.
- **PDB**: Minimum availability set to ensure rolling updates or node drains do not drop critical workloads below 50% capacity.
</file>

<file path="docs/deployment/PRODUCTION-DEPLOYMENT-RUNBOOK.md">
# Production Deployment Runbook

## Deployment Execution (GitOps via ArgoCD)
1. **Approval**: CI pipeline successfully updates the GitOps manifest repo. Pull Request to `production` branch is approved by Tech Lead.
2. **Sync**: ArgoCD detects the change on the `production` branch and triggers a sync.
3. **Rollout**: Kubernetes executes a RollingUpdate. 
4. **Probes**: Readiness probes hold traffic until new pods initialize dependencies (Redis, Postgres).
5. **Database Migrations**: Executed as a pre-sync hook job or dedicated init-container strategy. Must be backward-compatible with the running N-1 application version.
6. **Smoke Test**: Automated post-deploy validation (Auth check, critical API health).
</file>

<file path="docs/deployment/ROLLBACK-RUNBOOK.md">
# Rollback Runbook

## ArgoCD Rollback
1. **Git Revert**: The primary rollback mechanism is to revert the GitOps repository commit to the previous stable state.
2. **Sync**: ArgoCD detects the revert and syncs Kubernetes back to the N-1 image digest.

## Database Rollback Considerations
- **CRITICAL**: Application rollbacks MUST NOT trigger automatic database schema down-migrations. Down-migrations often involve destructive data loss.
- **Backward Compatibility**: Migrations must follow Expand/Contract patterns so that N-1 code can safely run against N schema during an emergency rollback.
</file>

<file path="docs/devsecops/DEVSECOPS-RUNBOOK.md">
# DevSecOps Runbook

## CI Pipeline Stages (Quality Gates)
1. **Checkout & Secret Scan**: Gitleaks fails build if secrets are detected.
2. **Build & Unit Tests**: .NET `dotnet build` and `dotnet test`.
3. **SAST**: Static analysis fails on Critical/High findings.
4. **Container Build**: Multi-stage Dockerfile builds minimal runtime image.
5. **Trivy Container Scan**: Fails pipeline on Critical/High CVEs.
6. **SBOM Generation**: Output pushed as Jenkins artifact.
7. **Image Push**: Secure push to Private Registry.
8. **GitOps Update**: Jenkins commits updated image tag/digest to the ArgoCD target repository.

## Vault Secret Rotation Strategy
- Database credentials rotated via Vault Dynamic Secrets.
- JWT Signing keys rotated with overlapping validation windows to prevent sudden session invalidation.
</file>

<file path="docs/devsecops/PHASE-15.9-DEVSECOPS-INVENTORY.md">
# Platform DevSecOps Inventory

## 1. CI/CD Pipeline (Target Architecture)
- **CI Server**: Jenkins (Pipeline as Code via `Jenkinsfile`).
- **Container Registry**: Secure Private Registry.
- **GitOps Controller**: ArgoCD.

## 2. Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- **Provisioning**: Terraform (Network, Kubernetes clusters, managed Postgres databases).
- **Configuration**: Ansible (for baseline OS hardening on worker nodes, if applicable).

## 3. Security Scanning & Compliance
- **SAST**: Roslyn Analyzers (.NET) & ESLint/SonarQube (React).
- **Secret Scanning**: Gitleaks (pre-commit and CI boundary).
- **Container Scanning**: Trivy (scans image layers before push to registry).
- **IaC Scanning**: Checkov/Terrascan (scans Terraform modules for misconfigurations).
- **SBOM**: Syft (generates SPDX/CycloneDX for supply chain verification).

## 4. Secret Management
- **Primary Vault**: HashiCorp Vault.
- **Kubernetes Integration**: Vault Agent Injector / External Secrets Operator to prevent plaintext Kubernetes `Secret` resources in Git.
</file>

<file path="docs/dr/PHASE-15.8-BACKUP-STRATEGY.md">
# Backup and Disaster Recovery Strategy

## 1. PostgreSQL (Transactional Data)
- **Type**: Logical backups (pg_dump) + WAL archiving (pgBackRest/Barman).
- **Frequency**: Continuous WAL archiving. Full backup daily.
- **Retention**: 30 days hot, 7 years cold (Audit/Customs compliance).
- **PITR**: Enabled. Can restore to any second within the 30-day window.

## 2. MinIO (Object Storage - Evidence/Documents)
- **Type**: Bucket replication + Versioning.
- **Frequency**: Continuous active-active replication to standby cluster.
- **Retention**: Indefinite for Customs Evidence (ANPR images, manifests).

## 3. Redis (Cache / Backplane)
- **Type**: Ephemeral (No backup required).
- **Recovery**: System designed to safely degrade and rebuild cache from authoritative PostgreSQL data upon Redis restart.

## 4. RabbitMQ (Messaging)
- **Type**: Configuration backup (Definitions JSON).
- **Data Recovery**: Queues are durable, but in a catastrophic broker loss, services rely on the EF Core Outbox table in PostgreSQL to republish unpublished integration events.
</file>

<file path="docs/dr/RPO-RTO.md">
# RPO and RTO Targets (Engineering Specifications)

| Service | RPO Target (Max Data Loss) | RTO Target (Max Downtime) | Observed RPO | Observed RTO | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **API Gateway** | 0 (Stateless) | < 1 minute | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **Identity** | 0 (PITR) | < 5 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **Customs (Core)** | 0 (PITR + Outbox) | < 15 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **Payment (Core)**| 0 (PITR + Ledger) | < 15 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **GPS (Telemetry)**| < 5 minutes | < 30 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **ANPR (Edge)** | < 1 minute | < 15 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
| **RabbitMQ** | < 1 minute (Outbox) | < 10 minutes | N/A | N/A | **NOT TESTED** |
</file>

<file path="docs/production/production-readiness-scorecard.md">
# Production Readiness Scorecard

> [!WARNING]
> **INFRASTRUCTURE LIMITATION**
> The current execution environment lacks a `.NET SDK` (verified via `dotnet --info`), preventing backend compilation (`dotnet build`), automated testing (`dotnet test`), and service initialization. Consequently, many backend validations could not be executed and are marked as **FAIL / NOT EXECUTED**.
> 
> No results have been fabricated.

## Categories

| Category | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Architecture** | PARTIAL | Verified Clean Architecture boundaries statically. Corrected duplicate/incorrect dependency injections manually. Cannot verify runtime dependencies without compilation. |
| **Security** | PARTIAL | Removed hardcoded JWT secrets, fixed weak password hashing references, and removed generic exceptions. DAST/SAST not executed due to missing SDK. |
| **Authentication** | NOT EXECUTED | Identity service cannot be built or run. |
| **Authorization** | NOT EXECUTED | Policy logic verified in `Program.cs`, but runtime enforcement cannot be tested. |
| **Multi-tenancy** | PARTIAL | Fixed `ECTN` sequence generation to respect tenant isolation. Runtime queries not tested. |
| **Database** | NOT EXECUTED | EF Core migrations cannot be generated or applied without `dotnet ef`. |
| **API** | NOT EXECUTED | OpenAPI generation (Swashbuckle) fails without build. |

<file path="docs/release/PHASE-15.10-REPOSITORY-AUDIT.md">
# Phase 15.10 Final Repository Audit

## 1. Architectural Blueprint
The Smart Trade & Logistics Corridor Platform repository contains the structural scaffolding for:
- 14 .NET 10 Microservices (Identity, Customs, Payment, GPS, etc.)
- React Enterprise Portal BFF (YARP API Gateway)
- Flutter Driver Mobile Architecture
- Outbox/Inbox Idempotency messaging contracts.

## 2. Outstanding Blockers (The Missing SDKs)
Despite the structural scaffolding, **zero lines of code have been compiled**. The host environment lacks:
- `.NET 8 SDK` / `.NET 10 SDK`
- `Flutter SDK`
- `Docker`, `Kubernetes`, `Jenkins`, `Vault`

## 3. Structural Deficiencies Detected
- **Build Failures**: Expected 100% failure rate if `dotnet build` is attempted due to missing SDK.
- **Fake/Mock Production Logic**: Cannot be verified. The code hasn't compiled.
- **Hard-coded Secrets**: None detected in structural scaffolding, but dynamic Vault injection is untested.
- **Missing Observability**: OpenTelemetry scaffolding exists, but cannot be verified against Jaeger/Prometheus.

## 4. Conclusion
The repository exists purely as structural text. It is not currently executable software.
</file>

<file path="docs/resilience/PHASE-15.8-RESILIENCE-INVENTORY.md">
# Platform Resilience Inventory

## 1. Retry Policies (Polly)
- **Database (EF Core)**: Uses `EnableRetryOnFailure()` for transient SQL connection errors.
- **Messaging (MassTransit)**: Configured with `UseMessageRetry(r => r.Interval(3, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))`.
- **External Providers (Payment)**: Uses Exponential Backoff with Jitter for external HTTP calls to prevent retry storms on provider failure.

## 2. Circuit Breakers
- **API Gateway (YARP)**: Rejects traffic to backend pools that fail consecutive health checks, failing fast for the client.
- **Customs to Fleet**: Circuit breaker triggers after 50% failure rate over 30 seconds, returning degraded cache state where permitted.

## 3. Data Durability & Idempotency
- **Outbox Pattern**: All 14 microservices use EF Core Outbox (`OutboxMessage.cs`) to guarantee atomicity between Postgres business state and RabbitMQ event publishing.
- **Inbox Pattern**: Consumers check `InboxMessage` table to ensure duplicate RabbitMQ deliveries (at-least-once guarantee) do not result in double ledger entries or duplicate customs clearance.

## 4. Kubernetes Resilience
- **Probes**: Liveness (TCP), Readiness (HTTP `/health`), and Startup probes configured for all API pods.
- **PodDisruptionBudget (PDB)**: Ensures minimum 1 replica available during node drains.
</file>

<file path="docs/security/PHASE-15.6-SECURITY-BASELINE.md">
# Phase 15.6 Security Baseline

## 1. Zero Trust Architecture
The Smart Trade & Logistics Corridor Platform operates on a strict Zero Trust model. Internal network location (e.g., executing within the Kubernetes cluster) does NOT confer trust. 

All service-to-service communication, including MassTransit/RabbitMQ integration events and internal REST API calls, MUST carry cryptographic proof of identity and tenant context (e.g., `X-Correlation-ID`, `X-Tenant-Id` derived from a validated OAuth2 JWT).

## 2. Trust Boundaries
- **Untrusted (Internet)**: Driver Mobile App, ANPR Cameras, External Payment Providers, Browser Clients.
- **Verification (Edge)**: API Gateway (YARP). Validates JWT signature, expiration, and issuer. Rejects malformed requests before routing.
- **Authorization (BFF & Domain)**: Control Tower BFF, Domain Microservices. Evaluate claims (Role, Permission, Tenant) against the requested resource. Frontend authorization (`RequirePermission.tsx`) is strictly for UX, not security.
- **Core (Database/Event Bus)**: PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ. Protected by mutual TLS (mTLS) and least-privilege service accounts.

## 3. Structural SAST Findings (from Scaffolding)
- `IIntegrationEvent.cs`: **PASS**. Strictly requires `TenantId`, preventing ambient cross-tenant contamination in the event stream.
- `RequirePermission.tsx`: **PASS**. Correctly assumes frontend is not the security boundary.
- `ControlTowerHub.cs`: **PASS**. Correctly partitions WebSocket connections by `Tenant_{tenantId}` during `OnConnectedAsync` to prevent SignalR event leakage.
</file>

<file path="docs/security/threat-model.md">
# Platform Threat Model

## 1. Threat Actors
- **External Attacker**: Attempts API enumeration, credential stuffing, and DDoS against the API Gateway.
- **Malicious Tenant (Logistics/Trader)**: Attempts IDOR/BOLA to access competing tenant's cargo data, customs holds, or GPS telemetry.
- **Compromised GPS/ANPR Device**: Attempts to spoof location data or fabricate gate authorizations to bypass customs checks.
- **Insider Threat**: Unauthorized attempts by internal users (e.g., Driver) to elevate privileges to Logistics Admin or Customs Officer.

## 2. Threat Categories (STRIDE)
- **Spoofing**: Faking ANPR events to clear a border. *Mitigation*: mTLS and cryptographic device credentials at the ingestion API.
- **Tampering**: Altering Customs Assessment rates (e.g., from 15% to 10%) via intercepted React payload. *Mitigation*: Backend calculates authoritative values from read-only Government Configuration; ignores client-supplied duty rates.
- **Repudiation**: Driver denying receipt of goods. *Mitigation*: Immutable Audit trails and EF Core Outbox pattern ensuring DeliveryConfirmed events are durable.
- **Information Disclosure**: Tenant A reading Tenant B's SignalR feed. *Mitigation*: Strict SignalR group isolation in `ControlTowerHub.cs`.
- **Denial of Service**: High-frequency GPS flooding. *Mitigation*: YARP Rate Limiting and Payload Size constraints.
- **Elevation of Privilege**: Driver attempting to hit `/api/v1/government/tariff`. *Mitigation*: Strict JWT Role and Permission claims validated at the Domain Controller level.
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/api/client.ts">
import axios from 'axios';

// The BFF / API Gateway handles routing this to the correct backend microservice
export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: '/api/v1',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  withCredentials: true, // Crucial for HttpOnly cookies provided by BFF Identity
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      // Dispatch global event or call auth store to redirect to login
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);
</file>

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes by default
      retry: 2,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false, // Enterprise apps usually prefer manual refresh for heavy grids
    },
  },
});

<file path="frontend/web/src/app/auth/RequirePermission.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

interface RequirePermissionProps {
  children: JSX.Element;
  requiredPermission?: string;
  requiredRole?: string;
  requiredTenantAccess?: string;
}

// Mock auth hook for scaffolding
const useAuth = () => {
  return {
    isAuthenticated: true,
    user: {
      roles: ['CUSTOMS_OFFICER'],
      permissions: ['customs.configuration.read'],
      tenantType: 'GOVERNMENT',
    },
    isLoading: false,
  };
};

export const RequirePermission: React.FC<RequirePermissionProps> = ({
  children,
  requiredPermission,
  requiredRole,
  requiredTenantAccess,
}) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading session...</div>;

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  if (requiredRole && !user.roles.includes(requiredRole)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  if (requiredPermission && !user.permissions.includes(requiredPermission)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  if (requiredTenantAccess && user.tenantType !== requiredTenantAccess) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  return children;
};
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/app/providers/QueryProvider.tsx">
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import React, { ReactNode } from 'react';

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      retry: 1,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes cache
    },
  },
});

export const QueryProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {children}
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
};
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/app/RequireAuth.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
// import { useAuthStore } from '../stores/authStore'; // Imaginary global state store

export const RequireAuth: React.FC = () => {
  // const { isAuthenticated, isInitializing } = useAuthStore();
  const isAuthenticated = true; // Mocked for scaffolding
  const isInitializing = false;
  const location = useLocation();

  if (isInitializing) {
    return <div>Loading authentication state...</div>;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export const RequirePermission: React.FC<{ permission: string }> = ({ permission }) => {
  // const { permissions } = useAuthStore();
  const permissions = ['control-tower.read']; // Mocked
  const hasPermission = permissions.includes(permission);

  if (!hasPermission) {
    return <Navigate to="/403" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/features/controlTower/hooks/useControlTowerOverview.ts">
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api } from '../api/client';

interface ControlTowerOverview {
  activeTrips: number;
  vehiclesLive: number;
  vehiclesStale: number;
  pendingCustoms: number;
  openAlerts: number;
}

export const useControlTowerOverview = () => {
  return useQuery<ControlTowerOverview>({
    queryKey: ['control-tower', 'overview'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const response = await api.get('/control-tower/overview');
      return response.data;
    },
    // The query is refreshed when a specific SignalR event arrives (in a separate hook), 
    // but we can also set a slow polling interval as a fallback
    refetchInterval: 30000, 
  });
};
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/services/api/apiClient.ts">
import axios from 'axios';

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_GATEWAY_URL || '/api/v1',
  timeout: 10000,
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  // Inject JWT from secure storage/cookie
  const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      // Trigger global logout / session refresh
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }
    // Never expose stack traces to user
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);
</file>

<file path="frontend/web/src/App.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { queryClient } from './api/queryClient';
import { RequireAuth, RequirePermission } from './app/RequireAuth';

// Placeholder Pages
const Login = () => <div>Login Page</div>;
const Forbidden = () => <div>403 Forbidden</div>;
const LogisticsDashboard = () => <div>Logistics Company Dashboard</div>;
const GovernmentDashboard = () => <div>Government Operations Dashboard</div>;
const ControlTower = () => <div>Enterprise Control Tower (Map + Alerts)</div>;

const App = () => {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
          <Route path="/403" element={<Forbidden />} />

          {/* Secure Routes */}
          <Route element={<RequireAuth />}>
            
            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/logistics/dashboard" replace />} />
            
            {/* Logistics Portal */}
            <Route path="/logistics">
              <Route path="dashboard" element={<LogisticsDashboard />} />
              {/* Other logistics routes... */}
            </Route>

            {/* Government Portal */}
            <Route path="/government">
              <Route path="dashboard" element={<GovernmentDashboard />} />
              {/* Other gov routes... */}
            </Route>

            {/* Control Tower - Protected by specific permission */}
            <Route element={<RequirePermission permission="control-tower.read" />}>
              <Route path="/control-tower" element={<ControlTower />} />
            </Route>

          </Route>
        </Routes>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
};

export default App;

<file path="mobile/driver/lib/core/networking/api_client.dart">
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

class ApiClient {
  final Dio _dio;
  final FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage;
  static const String _tokenKey = 'access_token';
  static const String _refreshTokenKey = 'refresh_token';

  ApiClient({required String baseUrl, required FlutterSecureStorage secureStorage})
      : _secureStorage = secureStorage,
        _dio = Dio(BaseOptions(
          baseUrl: baseUrl,
          connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15),
          receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15),
        )) {
    _dio.interceptors.add(_createAuthInterceptor());
    _dio.interceptors.add(_createRetryInterceptor());
  }

  Interceptor _createAuthInterceptor() {
    return InterceptorsWrapper(
      onRequest: (options, handler) async {
        final token = await _secureStorage.read(key: _tokenKey);
        if (token != null) {
          options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
        }
        
        // Inject Idempotency-Key for POST/PUT requests
        if (options.method == 'POST' || options.method == 'PUT') {
          options.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = const Uuid().v4();
        }
        
        // Inject CorrelationId
        options.headers['X-Correlation-ID'] = const Uuid().v4();
        
        return handler.next(options);
      },
      onError: (DioException e, handler) async {
        if (e.response?.statusCode == 401) {
          // Attempt token refresh logic here
          // If refresh fails, clear session and throw specific AuthException
          await _secureStorage.delete(key: _tokenKey);
          await _secureStorage.delete(key: _refreshTokenKey);
          // throw AuthException('Session expired');
        }
        return handler.next(e);
      },
    );
  }

  Interceptor _createRetryInterceptor() {
    return InterceptorsWrapper(
      onError: (DioException e, handler) {
        // Implement exponential backoff for 5xx and 429
        if (e.response?.statusCode == 429 || (e.response?.statusCode ?? 0) >= 500) {
           // Queue for retry logic
        }
        return handler.next(e);
      }
    );
  }
}
</file>

<file path="mobile/driver/lib/core/synchronization/offline_queue.dart">
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

enum OfflineEventStatus { Pending, Sending, Succeeded, Failed, DeadLetter }

class OfflineEvent {
  final String localId;
  final String eventType;
  final String aggregateType;
  final String aggregateId;
  final DateTime createdAtUtc;
  final Map<String, dynamic> payload;
  int retryCount;
  OfflineEventStatus status;
  String? errorCode;

  OfflineEvent({
    required this.eventType,
    required this.aggregateType,
    required this.aggregateId,
    required this.payload,
  })  : localId = const Uuid().v4(),
        createdAtUtc = DateTime.now().toUtc(),
        retryCount = 0,
        status = OfflineEventStatus.Pending;
}

abstract class IOfflineQueueRepository {
  Future<void> enqueue(OfflineEvent event);
  Future<List<OfflineEvent>> getPendingEvents();
  Future<void> updateEventStatus(String localId, OfflineEventStatus status);
  Future<void> incrementRetry(String localId);
}

class OfflineSyncEngine {
  final IOfflineQueueRepository _repository;
  // final ApiClient _apiClient;

  OfflineSyncEngine(this._repository);

  Future<void> syncPendingEvents() async {
    final pending = await _repository.getPendingEvents();
    for (var event in pending) {
      try {
        await _repository.updateEventStatus(event.localId, OfflineEventStatus.Sending);
        // Simulate API call using ApiClient
        // await _apiClient.post('/api/sync', data: event.payload);
        await _repository.updateEventStatus(event.localId, OfflineEventStatus.Succeeded);
      } catch (e) {
        // Handle permanent vs transient errors
        await _repository.incrementRetry(event.localId);
        // If max retries, move to DeadLetter
      }
    }
  }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Api/Controllers/BerthAllocationsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using AisVessel.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace AisVessel.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ais/berth-allocations")]
[Authorize]
public class BerthAllocationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public BerthAllocationsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ais.berth.allocate")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AllocateBerth([FromBody] AllocateBerthCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var portCallId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(new { PortCallId = portCallId, Status = "BerthAllocated" });
    }
}

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Application/Commands/AllocateBerthCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;
using AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace AisVessel.Application.Commands;

public class AllocateBerthCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid PortCallId { get; set; }
    public Guid BerthId { get; set; }
}

public class AllocateBerthCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AllocateBerthCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly AisDbContext _context;

    public AllocateBerthCommandHandler(AisDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(AllocateBerthCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var portCall = await _context.PortCalls
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == request.PortCallId && p.TenantId == request.TenantId, cancellationToken);
            
        if (portCall == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("PortCall not found.");
        
        var berth = await _context.Berths
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(b => b.Id == request.BerthId && b.TenantId == request.TenantId, cancellationToken);
            
        if (berth == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Berth not found.");

        if (portCall.Status != PortCallStatus.AwaitingBerth)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("PortCall must be AwaitingBerth to allocate a berth.");
        }

        portCall.AdvanceState(PortCallStatus.BerthAllocated);
        
        // Example: in full implementation, we'd add the BerthAllocation entity here,
        // evaluate the IBerthAllocationService rules to ensure Length/Draft match,
        // and raise a BerthAllocatedIntegrationEvent via Outbox.
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return portCall.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Domain/Entities/Berth.cs">
using System;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;

namespace AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

public class Berth
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string PortCode { get; private set; }
    public string TerminalReference { get; private set; }
    public string BerthCode { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    
    public BerthStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public double Length { get; private set; }
    public double MaximumDraft { get; private set; }
    public double MaximumDWT { get; private set; }
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Berth() { }

    public Berth(
        Guid tenantId,
        string portCode,
        string berthCode,
        double length,
        double maxDraft)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        PortCode = portCode;
        BerthCode = berthCode;
        Length = length;
        MaximumDraft = maxDraft;
        Active = true;
        Status = BerthStatus.Available;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
    
    public bool CanAccommodate(Vessel vessel)
    {
        return Active && Status != BerthStatus.Closed &&
               vessel.LengthOverall <= Length &&
               vessel.Draft <= MaximumDraft;
    }
}

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Domain/Entities/PortCall.cs">
using System;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;

namespace AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

public class PortCall
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid VesselId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? VoyageId { get; private set; }
    public string PortCode { get; private set; }
    public string TerminalReference { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime? ETA { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ETD { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ATA { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ATD { get; private set; }
    
    public PortCallStatus Status { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected PortCall() { }

    public PortCall(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid vesselId,
        string portCode,
        DateTime? eta)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        VesselId = vesselId;
        PortCode = portCode;
        ETA = eta;
        Status = PortCallStatus.Expected;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void AdvanceState(PortCallStatus nextState)
    {
        // Add basic state machine validation rules here
        if (Status == PortCallStatus.Departed || Status == PortCallStatus.Cancelled)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot change state of a completed or cancelled port call.");
        }
        
        Status = nextState;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Domain/Entities/PortZone.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using AisVessel.Domain.Enums;

namespace AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

public class PortZone
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string PortCode { get; private set; }
    public PortZoneType Type { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS Geometry for Polygon/MultiPolygon
    public Geometry Boundary { get; private set; }
    
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected PortZone() { }

    public PortZone(
        Guid tenantId,
        string portCode,
        string name,
        PortZoneType type,
        Geometry boundary)
    {
        if (boundary == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(boundary));
        
        // Ensure SRID is set
        if (boundary.SRID == 0) boundary.SRID = 4326;

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        PortCode = portCode;
        Name = name;
        Type = type;
        Boundary = boundary;
        Active = true;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

    public DateTime? LastAISReceivedAt { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

        Guid tenantId,
        string vesselName,
        string imo,
        string mmsi,
        VesselType vesselType,
        double lengthOverall,
        double draft)

        VesselName = vesselName;
        IMO = imo;
        MMSI = mmsi;

        Draft = draft;
        Status = VesselStatus.AtSea;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void UpdateStatus(VesselStatus newStatus)
    {
        Status = newStatus;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

<file path="services/ais-vessel/AisVessel.Infrastructure/Persistence/AisDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AisVessel.Domain.Entities;

namespace AisVessel.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AisDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<Vessel> Vessels { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PortCall> PortCalls { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Berth> Berths { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PortZone> PortZones { get; set; }

    public AisDbContext(DbContextOptions<AisDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<Vessel>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.IMO).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.MMSI).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<PortCall>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Berth>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.PortCode, e.BerthCode }).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<PortZone>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Boundary).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Boundary).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Api/Controllers/KpiController.cs">
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Analytics.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/analytics/kpis")]
[Authorize]
public class KpiController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public KpiController(AnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    [HttpGet("transit-time")]
    // [Authorize(Policy = "analytics.kpi.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTransitTimeKpi([FromQuery] Guid? tenantId)
    {
        // Extract TenantId from JWT to enforce tenant isolation unless user is Platform Admin
        var userTenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("TenantId")?.Value ?? tenantId.ToString() ?? Guid.Empty.ToString());
        
        // In a real scenario, this would query a materialized view or perform an aggregated query on FactTripMilestone
        // calculating the P95 transit time.
        
        var baseQuery = _context.FactTripMilestones.AsQueryable();
        
        if (userTenantId != Guid.Empty)
        {
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(f => f.TenantId == userTenantId);
        }
        
        var avgDuration = await baseQuery
            .Where(f => f.ActualDurationFromStart.HasValue)
            .AverageAsync(f => f.ActualDurationFromStart.Value.TotalHours);

        return Ok(new 
        { 
            Code = "avg-transit-time",
            Name = "Average Transit Time",
            Value = avgDuration,
            Unit = "Hours"
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Application/Commands/GenerateReportCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Analytics.Application.Commands;

public class GenerateReportCommand : IRequest<string> // Returns Signed URL of the generated report
{
    public Guid ReportDefinitionId { get; set; }
    public Guid? RequestingTenantId { get; set; } // Enforce Security
}

public class GenerateReportCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<GenerateReportCommand, string>
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _context;
    
    public GenerateReportCommandHandler(AnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<string> Handle(GenerateReportCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Fetch ReportDefinition
        var def = await _context.ReportDefinitions.FindAsync(new object[] { request.ReportDefinitionId }, cancellationToken);
        if (def == null) throw new Exception("Report Definition not found.");
        
        // 2. Validate Security (Tenant Isolation)
        if (def.TenantId.HasValue && def.TenantId != request.RequestingTenantId)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Cannot generate a report for a different tenant.");
        }
        
        // 3. Generate Report Data based on the Definition (e.g. querying Fact tables)
        // 4. Generate PDF/Excel payload
        // 5. Save to MinIO/S3
        // 6. Generate presigned URL
        
        return await Task.FromResult("https://storage.smartcorridor.com/reports/xyz-123.pdf?signature=xxx");
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Application/Consumers/TripMilestoneConsumer.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MassTransit;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;
using Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Analytics.Application.Consumers;

public class TripMilestoneEvent
{
    public Guid EventId { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid TripId { get; set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; set; }
    public string MilestoneType { get; set; }
    public string LocationName { get; set; }
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? ExpectedDuration { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? ActualDuration { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan? DelayDuration { get; set; }
}

public class TripMilestoneConsumer : IConsumer<TripMilestoneEvent>
{
    private readonly AnalyticsDbContext _context;

    public TripMilestoneConsumer(AnalyticsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task Consume(ConsumeContext<TripMilestoneEvent> context)
    {
        var msg = context.Message;
        
        // Idempotency Check: Don't ingest the same event twice
        var exists = await _context.FactTripMilestones.AnyAsync(f => f.SourceEventId == msg.EventId);
        if (exists) return;

        // Data Quality Rule: Log and skip negative durations
        if (msg.ActualDuration.HasValue && msg.ActualDuration.Value.TotalSeconds < 0)
        {
            // Ideally, we'd log this into a DataQualityIssue table
            return;
        }

        var fact = new FactTripMilestone(
            msg.TenantId,
            msg.TripId,
            msg.VehicleId,
            msg.CorridorId,
            msg.MilestoneType,
            msg.LocationName,
            msg.OccurredAt,
            msg.ExpectedDuration,
            msg.ActualDuration,
            msg.DelayDuration,
            msg.EventId
        );

        _context.FactTripMilestones.Add(fact);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

using System;

namespace Analytics.Domain.Entities;

public class FactTripMilestone
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid TripId { get; private set; }
    
    // Dimension References
    public Guid VehicleId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; private set; }
    
    // Core details
    public string MilestoneType { get; private set; } // e.g., "PortExit", "BorderCrossing", "DryPortArrival"
    public string LocationName { get; private set; }
    
    // Analytics Metrics
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? ExpectedDurationFromStart { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? ActualDurationFromStart { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan? DelayDuration { get; private set; }
    
    // Data Lineage
    public Guid SourceEventId { get; private set; }
    public DateTime ProcessedAt { get; private set; }

    protected FactTripMilestone() { }

    public FactTripMilestone(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid tripId,
        Guid vehicleId,
        Guid corridorId,
        string milestoneType,
        string locationName,
        DateTime occurredAt,
        TimeSpan? expectedDuration,
        TimeSpan? actualDuration,
        TimeSpan? delayDuration,
        Guid sourceEventId)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        TripId = tripId;
        VehicleId = vehicleId;
        CorridorId = corridorId;
        MilestoneType = milestoneType;
        LocationName = locationName;
        OccurredAt = occurredAt;
        ExpectedDurationFromStart = expectedDuration;
        ActualDurationFromStart = actualDuration;
        DelayDuration = delayDuration;
        SourceEventId = sourceEventId;
        ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/Persistence/AnalyticsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Analytics.Domain.Entities;

namespace Analytics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AnalyticsDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<DimTenant> DimTenants { get; set; }
    public DbSet<FactTripMilestone> FactTripMilestones { get; set; }
    public DbSet<KpiDefinition> KpiDefinitions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<ReportDefinition> ReportDefinitions { get; set; }

    public AnalyticsDbContext(DbContextOptions<AnalyticsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // PostGIS setup would normally happen here if we had spatial entities in this snippet (e.g. FactGpsEvent with Point geography)
        // modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<FactTripMilestone>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.OccurredAt }); // Frequent filtering pattern
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.SourceEventId).IsUnique(); // Idempotency check against double ingestion
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<KpiDefinition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Code); // Code is the primary identifier for KPIs
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<ReportDefinition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            // Global reports + Tenant specific ones
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Api/Controllers/AnprIngestionController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using AnprGate.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace AnprGate.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/anpr/ingest")]
// Note: Normally machine-to-machine APIs use a different policy (e.g. certificate auth or custom device tokens)
[Authorize]
public class AnprIngestionController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public AnprIngestionController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "anpr.camera.machine")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Ingest([FromBody] IngestRecognitionCommand command)
    {
        // Determine TenantId from authenticated camera context, NEVER from payload
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var recognitionId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Accepted(new { RecognitionEventId = recognitionId, Status = "Processing" });
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Application/Commands/IngestRecognitionCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using AnprGate.Domain.Entities;
using AnprGate.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace AnprGate.Application.Commands;

public class IngestRecognitionCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid CameraId { get; set; }
    public string PlateText { get; set; }
    public double Confidence { get; set; }
    public DateTime ObservedAt { get; set; }
    public string ProviderEventId { get; set; }
    // Note: Evidence bytes (image) would typically be passed/uploaded separately to S3,
    // and we'd store the metadata/hash. For simplicity, we just process the plate string.
}

public class IngestRecognitionCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<IngestRecognitionCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly AnprDbContext _context;

    public IngestRecognitionCommandHandler(AnprDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(IngestRecognitionCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // IPlateNormalizationService logic would go here.
        var normalizedPlate = request.PlateText.ToUpper().Replace(" ", "").Replace("-", "");

        var recognitionEvent = new RecognitionEvent(
            request.TenantId,
            request.CameraId,
            request.PlateText,
            normalizedPlate,
            request.Confidence,
            request.ObservedAt,
            request.ProviderEventId);
            
        _context.RecognitionEvents.Add(recognitionEvent);
        
        // Triggers the GateAuthorizationPolicy Engine via Outbox / Integration Events internally.
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return recognitionEvent.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Domain/Entities/Camera.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

public class Camera
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string CameraCode { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS location
    public Geometry Location { get; private set; }
    
    public string PortOrBorderReference { get; private set; }
    public Guid? GateId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? LaneId { get; private set; }
    
    public Direction Direction { get; private set; }
    public CameraType CameraType { get; private set; }
    
    public string Manufacturer { get; private set; }
    public string Model { get; private set; }
    public string SerialNumber { get; private set; }
    public string FirmwareVersion { get; private set; }
    
    public CameraStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? LastHeartbeatAt { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Camera() { }

    public Camera(Guid tenantId, string cameraCode, string name, CameraType type, Geometry location)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        CameraCode = cameraCode;
        Name = name;
        CameraType = type;
        
        if (location != null && location.SRID == 0) location.SRID = 4326;
        Location = location;
        
        Status = CameraStatus.Provisioning;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void UpdateHeartbeat()
    {
        LastHeartbeatAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (Status == CameraStatus.Offline)
        {
            Status = CameraStatus.Active;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

public class GateAuthorizationRequest
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid GateId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? LaneId { get; private set; }
    public Guid RecognitionEventId { get; private set; }
    
    public string ObservedPlate { get; private set; }
    public string MatchedVehicleId { get; private set; } // Reference to Fleet
    public string TripId { get; private set; } // Reference to Corridor
    public string CustomsReleaseReference { get; private set; } // Reference to Customs
    
    public AuthorizationStatus Status { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime RequestedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ExpiresAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? DecisionAt { get; private set; }
    
    public string DecisionReason { get; private set; }
    public string PolicyVersion { get; private set; }

    protected GateAuthorizationRequest() { }

    public GateAuthorizationRequest(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid gateId,
        Guid recognitionEventId,
        string observedPlate)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        GateId = gateId;
        RecognitionEventId = recognitionEventId;
        ObservedPlate = observedPlate;
        Status = AuthorizationStatus.Requested;
        RequestedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Authorize(string policyVersion)
    {
        Status = AuthorizationStatus.Authorized;
        DecisionAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        PolicyVersion = policyVersion;
    }

    public void Deny(string reason, string policyVersion)
    {
        Status = AuthorizationStatus.Denied;
        DecisionReason = reason;
        DecisionAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        PolicyVersion = policyVersion;
    }
}

using System;
using AnprGate.Domain.Enums;

namespace AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

public class RecognitionEvidence
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid RecognitionEventId { get; private set; }
    
    public string ObjectKey { get; private set; } // S3/MinIO Key
    public string Bucket { get; private set; }
    public string ContentType { get; private set; }
    public string Hash { get; private set; } // Cryptographic hash for integrity
    
    public DateTime CapturedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime UploadedAt { get; private set; }
    public long SizeBytes { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? RetentionUntil { get; private set; }

    protected RecognitionEvidence() { }

    public RecognitionEvidence(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid recognitionEventId,
        string bucket,
        string objectKey,
        string hash,
        string contentType,
        long sizeBytes,
        DateTime capturedAt)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        RecognitionEventId = recognitionEventId;
        Bucket = bucket;
        ObjectKey = objectKey;
        Hash = hash;
        ContentType = contentType;
        SizeBytes = sizeBytes;
        CapturedAt = capturedAt;
        UploadedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/anpr-gate/AnprGate.Infrastructure/Persistence/AnprDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using AnprGate.Domain.Entities;

namespace AnprGate.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class AnprDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<Camera> Cameras { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Gate> Gates { get; set; }
    public DbSet<RecognitionEvent> RecognitionEvents { get; set; }
    public DbSet<GateAuthorizationRequest> AuthorizationRequests { get; set; }
    public DbSet<RecognitionEvidence> Evidence { get; set; }

    public AnprDbContext(DbContextOptions<AnprDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<Camera>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.CameraCode).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Location).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Gate>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.GateCode).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Location).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RecognitionEvent>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.ProviderEventId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.NormalizedPlateText);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GateAuthorizationRequest>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<RecognitionEvidence>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Api/Controllers/TripsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Corridor.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Corridor.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/corridor/trips")]
[Authorize]
public class TripsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public TripsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("{tripId}/deviations/detect")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "corridor.trip.manage")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DetectDeviation(Guid tripId, [FromBody] DetectRouteDeviationCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }
        
        command.TripId = tripId;

        var deviated = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(new { TripId = tripId, Deviated = deviated });
    }
}

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Application/Commands/DetectRouteDeviationCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Corridor.Domain.Entities;
using Corridor.Domain.Enums;
using Corridor.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Corridor.Application.Commands;

public class DetectRouteDeviationCommand : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid TripId { get; set; }
    public double Latitude { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }
}

public class DetectRouteDeviationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DetectRouteDeviationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly CorridorDbContext _context;

    public DetectRouteDeviationCommandHandler(CorridorDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(DetectRouteDeviationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var trip = await _context.Trips
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == request.TripId && t.TenantId == request.TenantId, cancellationToken);
            
        if (trip == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Trip not found.");
        
        var routeVersion = await _context.RouteVersions
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Id == trip.RouteVersionId, cancellationToken);
            
        if (routeVersion == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("RouteVersion not found.");

        // Create a PostGIS Point from the incoming GPS coordinates
        var point = new NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point(request.Longitude, request.Latitude) { SRID = 4326 };

        // PostGIS distance check (simplified threshold comparison)
        // Note: In real projection ST_Distance with geography types provides meters.
        var distance = routeVersion.Geometry.Distance(point);
        var threshold = 0.005; // approx meters depending on projection

        if (distance > threshold)
        {
            // Route Deviation Detected
            // Publish event, create TripDeviation entity, etc.
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Domain/Entities/Checkpoint.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using Corridor.Domain.Enums;

namespace Corridor.Domain.Entities;

public class Checkpoint
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; private set; }
    public string Code { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public CheckpointType Type { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS Point geometry
    public Geometry Location { get; private set; }
    public double Radius { get; private set; } // Radius in meters
    
    public int Sequence { get; private set; }
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public int ExpectedDwellMinutes { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }

    protected Checkpoint() { }

    public Checkpoint(Guid tenantId, Guid corridorId, string code, string name, CheckpointType type, Geometry location, double radius)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        CorridorId = corridorId;
        Code = code;
        Name = name;
        Type = type;
        
        if (location.SRID == 0) location.SRID = 4326;
        Location = location;
        
        Radius = radius;
        Active = true;
    }
}

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Domain/Entities/Trip.cs">
using System;
using Corridor.Domain.Enums;

namespace Corridor.Domain.Entities;

public class Trip
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string TripNumber { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorridorId { get; private set; }
    public Guid RouteId { get; private set; }
    public Guid RouteVersionId { get; private set; }
    
    // External References
    public string FleetCompanyId { get; private set; }
    public string VehicleId { get; private set; }
    public string DriverId { get; private set; }
    public string VesselReference { get; private set; }
    public string CargoReference { get; private set; }
    public string CustomsCaseReference { get; private set; }
    
    public string Origin { get; private set; }
    public string Destination { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime? PlannedDeparture { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ActualDeparture { get; private set; }
    
    // Tracking State
    public Guid? CurrentMilestoneId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? CurrentCheckpointId { get; private set; }
    public double? CurrentLatitude { get; private set; }
    public double? CurrentLongitude { get; private set; }
    
    public TripStatus CurrentStatus { get; private set; }
    public double ProgressPercentage { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ETA { get; private set; }
    public string StatusReason { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Trip() { }

    public Trip(Guid tenantId, string tripNumber, Guid corridorId, Guid routeId, Guid routeVersionId)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        TripNumber = tripNumber;
        CorridorId = corridorId;
        RouteId = routeId;
        RouteVersionId = routeVersionId;
        CurrentStatus = TripStatus.Draft;
        ProgressPercentage = 0;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void AdvanceStatus(TripStatus nextStatus, string reason = null)
    {
        // Add basic state machine validation rules here
        if (CurrentStatus == TripStatus.Completed || CurrentStatus == TripStatus.Cancelled)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot change state of a completed or cancelled trip.");
        }
        
        CurrentStatus = nextStatus;
        StatusReason = reason;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/corridor/Corridor.Infrastructure/Persistence/CorridorDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Corridor.Domain.Entities;

namespace Corridor.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class CorridorDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<CorridorAggregate> Corridors { get; set; }
    public DbSet<RouteVersion> RouteVersions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Checkpoint> Checkpoints { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Trip> Trips { get; set; }

    public CorridorDbContext(DbContextOptions<CorridorDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<CorridorAggregate>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.CorridorCode).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteVersion>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(LineString,4326)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Checkpoint>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Location).HasColumnType("geometry(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Trip>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.TripNumber).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Api/Controllers/CustomsCasesController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Customs.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class CustomsCasesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public CustomsCasesController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.case.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateCase([FromBody] ReceiveDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        // TenantId would normally be resolved via middleware/claims, setting it explicitly for example
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }
        
        // UserId from claims
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "sub"))
        {
            command.UserId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("sub").Value);
        }

        var caseId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetCase), new { id = caseId }, new { CaseId = caseId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.case.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetCase(Guid id)
    {
        // Implementation for GetCaseQuery would go here
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Pending" });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/risk-assessment")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "customs.risk.assess")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> StartRiskAssessment(Guid id)
    {
        // Implementation to invoke RiskRuleEngine and update state
        return Accepted();
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Application/Commands/ReceiveDeclarationCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using FluentValidation;

namespace Customs.Application.Commands;

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationExternalId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; }
    public string ECTNExternalId { get; set; }
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; }
    public string ProcedureCode { get; set; }
    public string ImporterReference { get; set; }
    public string ExporterReference { get; set; }
    public string DeclarantReference { get; set; }
    public string PortOfEntry { get; set; }
    public string PortOfExit { get; set; }
    public string CountryOfOrigin { get; set; }
    public string CountryOfDestination { get; set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<ReceiveDeclarationCommand>
{
    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.DeclarationExternalId).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.DeclarationNumber).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.ProcedureCode).NotEmpty();
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId).NotEmpty();
    }
}

public interface ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator
{
    string Generate(Guid tenantId);
}

public interface ICustomsDbContext
{
    // DbSet for Entities (To be implemented by EF Core DbContext)
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    void AddCustomsCase(CustomsCase customsCase);
}

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ReceiveDeclarationCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDbContext _context;
    private readonly ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator _numberGenerator;

    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDbContext context, ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator numberGenerator)
    {
        _context = context;
        _numberGenerator = numberGenerator;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(ReceiveDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var caseNumber = _numberGenerator.Generate(request.TenantId);

        var customsCase = new CustomsCase(
            request.TenantId,
            request.DeclarationExternalId,
            request.DeclarationNumber,
            request.ECTNExternalId,
            request.ECTNNumber,
            caseNumber,
            request.ProcedureCode,
            request.ImporterReference,
            request.ExporterReference,
            request.DeclarantReference,
            request.PortOfEntry,
            request.PortOfExit,
            request.CountryOfOrigin,
            request.CountryOfDestination,
            request.UserId
        );

        _context.AddCustomsCase(customsCase);
        
        // Outbox event could be published here
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return customsCase.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Entities/Configuration/TariffSchedule.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Customs.Domain.Entities.Configuration;

public class TariffSchedule
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid? TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string Code { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Name { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Jurisdiction { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ProcedureType { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public ConfigurationStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public DateTime EffectiveFrom { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? EffectiveTo { get; private set; }
    public int Version { get; private set; }
    public string LegalBasis { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }

    private readonly List<TariffItem> _tariffItems = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<TariffItem> TariffItems => _tariffItems.AsReadOnly();

    protected TariffSchedule() { } // For EF Core

    public TariffSchedule(Guid tenantId, string code, string name, string description, string jurisdiction, string procedureType, string legalBasis, Guid createdBy)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        Code = code;
        Name = name;
        Description = description;
        Jurisdiction = jurisdiction;
        ProcedureType = procedureType;
        Status = ConfigurationStatus.Draft;
        Version = 1;
        LegalBasis = legalBasis;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void SubmitForReview(Guid submittedBy)
    {
        if (Status != ConfigurationStatus.Draft)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only draft schedules can be submitted for review.");
        Status = ConfigurationStatus.UnderReview;
        UpdatedBy = submittedBy;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Approve(Guid approvedBy)
    {
        if (Status != ConfigurationStatus.UnderReview)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only schedules under review can be approved.");
        if (approvedBy == CreatedBy)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Maker-checker policy violation: Creator cannot approve their own configuration.");
        
        Status = ConfigurationStatus.Approved;
        UpdatedBy = approvedBy;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Publish(Guid publishedBy, DateTime effectiveFrom)
    {
        if (Status != ConfigurationStatus.Approved)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only approved schedules can be published.");
        
        Status = ConfigurationStatus.Published;
        EffectiveFrom = effectiveFrom;
        UpdatedBy = publishedBy;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Supersede(Guid supersededBy, DateTime effectiveTo)
    {
        if (Status != ConfigurationStatus.Published)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only published schedules can be superseded.");
        
        Status = ConfigurationStatus.Superseded;
        EffectiveTo = effectiveTo;
        UpdatedBy = supersededBy;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
</file>

        RulesVersion = rulesVersion;
        OfficerId = officerId;
        Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Status = "Completed";
