<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Policies/CustomsStateTransitionPolicy.cs">
using System;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;

namespace Customs.Domain.Policies;

public interface ICustomsStateTransitionPolicy
{
    bool CanTransition(CustomsStatus currentStatus, CustomsStatus targetStatus);
    void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsCase customsCase, CustomsStatus targetStatus);
}

public class CustomsStateTransitionPolicy : ICustomsStateTransitionPolicy
{
    public bool CanTransition(CustomsStatus currentStatus, CustomsStatus targetStatus)
    {
        return (currentStatus, targetStatus) switch
        {
            (CustomsStatus.Received, CustomsStatus.ValidationPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.InspectionPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment, CustomsStatus.NoInspection) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.InspectionPending, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.NoInspection, CustomsStatus.Assessment) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.Assessment, CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed, CustomsStatus.PaymentPending) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed, CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview) => true, // if no payment required
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentPending, CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed, CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview, CustomsStatus.Cleared) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview, CustomsStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.Cleared, CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized) => true,
            (CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized, CustomsStatus.Released) => true,
            _ => false
        };
    }

    public void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsCase customsCase, CustomsStatus targetStatus)
    {
        if (!CanTransition(customsCase.Status, targetStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid state transition from {customsCase.Status} to {targetStatus}");
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Domain/Policies/DomainPolicies.cs">
using System;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;

namespace Customs.Domain.Policies;

public interface IRiskRuleEngine
{
    RiskResult Evaluate(CustomsCase customsCase);
}

public class RiskResult
{
    public RiskLevel Level { get; set; }
    public string[] MatchedRules { get; set; }
    public string[] Reasons { get; set; }
    public decimal RiskScore { get; set; }
}

public interface ICustomsValuationPolicy
{
    decimal CalculateCustomsValue(CustomsValuation valuation);
}

public class CustomsValuationPolicy : ICustomsValuationPolicy
{
    public decimal CalculateCustomsValue(CustomsValuation valuation)
    {
        if (valuation.Method == ValuationMethod.TransactionValue)
        {
            return (valuation.InvoiceValue + valuation.Freight + valuation.Insurance + valuation.OtherAdditions - valuation.OtherDeductions) * valuation.ExchangeRate;
        }
        
        // Default calculation for other methods until explicitly implemented
        return valuation.InvoiceValue * valuation.ExchangeRate;
    }
}

<file path="services/customs/Customs.Infrastructure/Persistence/CustomsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Threading;

namespace Customs.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class CustomsDbContext : DbContext, ICustomsDbContext
{
    public DbSet<CustomsCase> CustomsCases { get; set; }
    public DbSet<CustomsAssessment> CustomsAssessments { get; set; }
    public DbSet<TariffSchedule> TariffSchedules { get; set; }
    public DbSet<TariffItem> TariffItems { get; set; }
    public DbSet<CustomsValuation> CustomsValuations { get; set; }

    public CustomsDbContext(DbContextOptions<CustomsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<CustomsCase>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId); // Global query filter example
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.CaseNumber).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.DeclarationNumber);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.ECTNNumber);
            entity.Property(e => e.RowVersion).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<CustomsAssessment>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalCustomsValue).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalDuty).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalTaxes).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalOtherCharges).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalAssessment).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DutyAssessment>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.CustomsValue).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Quantity).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Rate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.CalculatedDuty).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<TaxAssessment>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.BaseAmount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Rate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Amount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TariffItem>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Rate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.MinimumRate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.MaximumRate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<CustomsValuation>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.DeclarationValue).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.InvoiceValue).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Freight).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Insurance).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.OtherAdditions).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.OtherDeductions).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.ConvertedValue).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.ExchangeRate).HasColumnType("decimal(18,6)"); // Higher precision for exchange rates
        });
    }

    public void AddCustomsCase(CustomsCase customsCase)
    {
        CustomsCases.Add(customsCase);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Api/Controllers/DeclarationsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Commands;

namespace Declaration.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/declarations")]
public class DeclarationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public DeclarationsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        // Enforce tenant isolation
        var tenantIdClaim = User.FindFirst("TenantId")?.Value;
        if (tenantIdClaim != null && Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            command.TenantId = tenantId;
        }
        else
        {
            return Forbid("DECLARATION_TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED");
        }

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = result }, result);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok(new { Id = id });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/submit")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.submit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Submit(Guid id, [FromBody] SubmitDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        var tenantIdClaim = User.FindFirst("TenantId")?.Value;
        if (tenantIdClaim != null && Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            command.TenantId = tenantId;
            command.DeclarationId = id;
        }
        else
        {
            return Forbid("DECLARATION_TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED");
        }

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }
    
    [HttpPost("{id}/review/start")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.review")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> StartReview(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok();
    }
    
    [HttpPost("{id}/accept")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.accept")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Accept(Guid id, [FromBody] AcceptDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        command.DeclarationId = id;
        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/reject")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "declaration.reject")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Reject(Guid id, [FromBody] RejectDeclarationCommand command)
    {
        command.DeclarationId = id;
        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(result);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Api/Program.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Declaration.Application.Commands;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.Authority = "https://identity-service"; 
        options.Audience = "declaration-api";
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.submit", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.submit"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.review", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.review"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.accept", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.accept"));
    options.AddPolicy("declaration.reject", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "declaration.reject"));
});

builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(CreateDeclarationCommand).Assembly));
builder.Services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(typeof(CreateDeclarationCommandValidator).Assembly);

builder.Services.AddDbContext<DeclarationDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

builder.Services.AddScoped<ICustomsDeclarationRepository, CustomsDeclarationRepository>();
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEctnServiceClient, EctnServiceClient>();

var app = builder.Build();

app.UseSwagger();
app.UseSwaggerUI();
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health/live", () => "Alive");
app.MapGet("/health/ready", () => "Ready");

app.Run();
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AcceptDeclarationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDeclarationRepository _repository;

    public AcceptDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDeclarationRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(AcceptDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var declaration = await _repository.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(request.DeclarationId, request.TenantId);
        
        if (declaration == null)
            throw new Exception("DECLARATION_NOT_FOUND");

        declaration.Accept(request.DeclarationNumber, request.UserId);
        
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(declaration);
        return true;
    }
}

using System;

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/CreateDeclarationCommandValidator.cs">
using FluentValidation;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class CreateDeclarationCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateDeclarationCommand>
{
    public CreateDeclarationCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty().WithMessage("TenantId is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.ApplicationReference).NotEmpty().WithMessage("ApplicationReference is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.ProcedureCode).NotEmpty().WithMessage("ProcedureCode is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.CreatedBy).NotEmpty().WithMessage("CreatedBy is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.DeclarationType).IsInEnum().WithMessage("Invalid DeclarationType.");
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/RejectDeclarationCommandHandler.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class RejectDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RejectDeclarationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDeclarationRepository _repository;

    public RejectDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDeclarationRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(RejectDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var declaration = await _repository.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(request.DeclarationId, request.TenantId);
        
        if (declaration == null)
            throw new Exception("DECLARATION_NOT_FOUND");

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ReasonCode) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Reason))
            throw new Exception("DECLARATION_REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED");

        // Assuming a Reject method exists in the aggregate or we manually update it
        // declaration.Reject(request.ReasonCode, request.Reason, request.UserId);
        
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(declaration);
        return true;
    }
}

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Application/Commands/SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;

namespace Declaration.Application.Commands;

public class SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SubmitDeclarationCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly ICustomsDeclarationRepository _repository;
    private readonly IEctnServiceClient _ectnClient;

    public SubmitDeclarationCommandHandler(ICustomsDeclarationRepository repository, IEctnServiceClient ectnClient)
    {
        _repository = repository;
        _ectnClient = ectnClient;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(SubmitDeclarationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var declaration = await _repository.GetByIdAndTenantAsync(request.DeclarationId, request.TenantId);
        
        if (declaration == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("DECLARATION_NOT_FOUND");

        // Validate ECTN
        var ectnValid = await _ectnClient.ValidateEctnAsync(request.EctnReference, request.TenantId);
        if (!ectnValid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("DECLARATION_ECTN_INVALID");

        declaration.AssignEctnReference(request.EctnReference);
        declaration.Submit(request.UserId);

        await _repository.UpdateAsync(declaration);
        
        return true;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Domain/Entities/CustomsDeclaration.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;

namespace Declaration.Domain.Entities;

public class CustomsDeclaration
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; private set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; private set; }
    public string ECTNReference { get; private set; } // External ECTN link
    public DeclarationType DeclarationType { get; private set; }
    public string ProcedureCode { get; private set; }
    public DeclarationStatus Status { get; private set; }

    public Guid? ImporterPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ExporterPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? DeclarantPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ConsigneePartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? NotifyPartyId { get; private set; }

    public string CountryOfOrigin { get; private set; }
    public string CountryOfExport { get; private set; }
    public string CountryOfDestination { get; private set; }

    public string PortOfEntry { get; private set; }
    public string PortOfLoading { get; private set; }
    public string PortOfDischarge { get; private set; }
    public string FinalDestination { get; private set; }

    public string TransportMode { get; private set; }
    public string TransportReference { get; private set; }

    public string Currency { get; private set; }

    public decimal TotalGrossWeight { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalNetWeight { get; private set; }
    public int TotalPackages { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalVolume { get; private set; }

    public DateTime? SubmissionDate { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ReviewDate { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? AcceptedDate { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? RejectedDate { get; private set; }

    public int CurrentVersion { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; private set; }

    public byte[] RowVersion { get; private set; }

    // Navigations
    private readonly List<DeclarationParty> _parties = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationParty> Parties => _parties.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationLine> _lines = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationLine> Lines => _lines.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationPackage> _packages = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationPackage> Packages => _packages.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationContainer> _containers = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationContainer> Containers => _containers.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationDocument> _documents = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationDocument> Documents => _documents.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationReference> _references = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationReference> References => _references.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<DeclarationStatusHistory> _statusHistory = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<DeclarationStatusHistory> StatusHistory => _statusHistory.AsReadOnly();

    protected CustomsDeclaration() { }

    public CustomsDeclaration(Guid tenantId, string applicationReference, DeclarationType declarationType, string procedureCode, Guid createdBy)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        ApplicationReference = applicationReference;
        DeclarationType = declarationType;
        ProcedureCode = procedureCode;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Status = DeclarationStatus.Draft;
        CurrentVersion = 1;
    }

    public void AssignEctnReference(string ectnReference)
    {
        if (Status != DeclarationStatus.Draft && Status != DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Can only assign ECTN reference to drafts or amendments.");
        ECTNReference = ectnReference;
    }

    public void Submit(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != DeclarationStatus.Draft)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only draft declarations can be submitted.");
        
        UpdateStatus(DeclarationStatus.Submitted, actorId, "Declaration submitted for validation");
        SubmissionDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Accept(string declarationNumber, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != DeclarationStatus.UnderReview && Status != DeclarationStatus.Validation)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Can only accept declarations that are under review.");
            
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber;
        UpdateStatus(DeclarationStatus.Accepted, actorId, "Declaration formally accepted");
        AcceptedDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    private void UpdateStatus(DeclarationStatus newStatus, Guid actorId, string reason)
    {
        Status = newStatus;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = actorId;
        _statusHistory.Add(new DeclarationStatusHistory(Id, TenantId, newStatus, actorId, reason));
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Domain/Entities/DeclarationAmendment.cs">
using System;

namespace Declaration.Domain.Entities;

public class DeclarationAmendment
{

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Domain/Policies/DeclarationStateTransitionPolicy.cs">
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Domain.Enums;
using System;

namespace Declaration.Domain.Policies;

public class DeclarationStateTransitionPolicy : IDeclarationStateTransitionPolicy
{
    public bool CanTransition(CustomsDeclaration declaration, DeclarationStatus targetStatus)
    {
        return (declaration.Status, targetStatus) switch
        {
            (DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Submitted) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Draft, DeclarationStatus.Cancelled) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Validation) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Submitted, DeclarationStatus.Cancelled) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Validation, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Validation, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.UnderReview, DeclarationStatus.Accepted) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.UnderReview, DeclarationStatus.Rejected) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Rejected, DeclarationStatus.Draft) => true, // Resubmission
            (DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Accepted, DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.AmendmentRequested, DeclarationStatus.UnderReview) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.AssessmentPending, DeclarationStatus.Cleared) => true,
            (DeclarationStatus.Cleared, DeclarationStatus.Released) => true,
            _ => false
        };
    }

    public void EnforceTransitionRules(CustomsDeclaration declaration, DeclarationStatus targetStatus)
    {
        if (!CanTransition(declaration, targetStatus))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid state transition from {declaration.Status} to {targetStatus}");
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Infrastructure/Persistence/DeclarationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class DeclarationDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<CustomsDeclaration> CustomsDeclarations { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationLine> DeclarationLines { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationParty> DeclarationParties { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationDocument> DeclarationDocuments { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationTransport> DeclarationTransports { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationContainer> DeclarationContainers { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationPackage> DeclarationPackages { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationReference> DeclarationReferences { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationStatusHistory> DeclarationStatusHistories { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DeclarationVersion> DeclarationVersions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; }
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; }

    public DeclarationDbContext(DbContextOptions<DeclarationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<CustomsDeclaration>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.RowVersion).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Indexes (Rule 49)
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.DeclarationNumber).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.ApplicationReference);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.ECTNReference);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Status);
        });

        // Other entity mappings go here
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Infrastructure/Repositories/CustomsDeclarationRepository.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CustomsDeclarationRepository : ICustomsDeclarationRepository
{
    private readonly DeclarationDbContext _context;

    public CustomsDeclarationRepository(DeclarationDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAndTenantAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.Id == id && d.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        await _context.CustomsDeclarations.AddAsync(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        _context.CustomsDeclarations.Update(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Infrastructure/Services/EctnServiceClient.cs">
using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Polly;
using Polly.CircuitBreaker;
using Polly.Retry;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnServiceClient : IEctnServiceClient
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> _retryPolicy;

    public EctnServiceClient(HttpClient httpClient)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        
        // Resilience policies (Rule 63)
        _retryPolicy = Policy
            .HandleResult<HttpResponseMessage>(r => !r.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retryAttempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt)));
    }

    public async Task<bool> ValidateEctnAsync(string ectnReference, Guid tenantId)
    {
        // In a real implementation, this would make an actual HTTP call to the ECTN Service.
        // It should NOT access the ECTN database directly (Rule 11).
        
        // Dummy implementation for now:
        return await Task.FromResult(true); 
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Application.Commands;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize] // Requires JWT from Phase 02
public class EctnController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public EctnController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.create")] // Requires explicit permission
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateEctnCommand command)
    {
        // Security Check: Ensure client cannot inject a different TenantId
        // The TenantId should be extracted from the authenticated user's JWT claims
        var tenantIdClaim = User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            command.TenantId = tenantId;
        }
        else
        {
            return Forbid("Tenant ID is missing from the authentication context.");
        }

        var actorIdClaim = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(actorIdClaim, out var actorId))
        {
            command.CreatedBy = actorId;
        }

        var ectnId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = ectnId }, new { Id = ectnId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get(Guid id)
    {
        // Implement GetQuery
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Draft" });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/submit")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.submit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Submit(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute SubmitEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN submitted successfully." });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/approve")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.approve")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Approve(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute ApproveEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN approved successfully." });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/issue")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.issue")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Issue(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute IssueEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN issued successfully." });
    }
}
</file>

using System.Threading.Tasks;

[Authorize(Policy = "ectn.statistics.read")]
public class EctnDashboardController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDashboardStatistics()
    {
        // Returns high-level metrics for the Control Tower / Dashboard (Rule 29)
        // Uses Fast read-only queries with .AsNoTracking()
        
        var metrics = new
        {
            TotalEctns = 0,
            PendingReview = 0,
            Approved = 0,
            Rejected = 0,
            AverageProcessingTimeMinutes = 0
        };

        return Ok(metrics);
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnDocumentsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ectn/{ectnId}/documents")]
[Authorize]
public class EctnDocumentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public EctnDocumentsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.documents.upload")]
    [RequestSizeLimit(10485760)] // 10 MB limit for security (Rule 48/49)
    public async Task<IActionResult> UploadDocument(Guid ectnId, IFormFile file, [FromForm] string documentType)
    {
        if (file == null || file.Length == 0)
            return BadRequest("File is empty or missing.");

        // Additional MIME and Extension Validation logic would live here
        
        // Pseudo-command: UploadDocumentCommand
        return Accepted(new { Message = "Document uploaded and pending malware scan." });
    }

    [HttpGet("{documentId}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.documents.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadDocument(Guid ectnId, Guid documentId)
    {
        // Enforce tenant isolation by verifying EctnId -> TenantId
        return Ok(new { Url = "https://minio.local/signed-url-for-download" });
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnSearchController.cs">
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/ectn/search")]
[Authorize(Policy = "ectn.read")]
public class EctnSearchController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Search([FromQuery] string ectnNumber, [FromQuery] string port, [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20)
    {
        // Enforce maximum page size to prevent abuse (Rule 28)
        if (pageSize > 100) pageSize = 100;

        // Perform optimized index-based search ensuring TenantId filtering is always applied via EF Core Global Filters
        
        return Ok(new { Page = page, PageSize = pageSize, TotalCount = 0, Results = new object[] { } });
    }
}

            Status = "Valid",

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Program.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.Text;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Configure MediatR (CQRS)
builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(Ectn.Application.Commands.CreateEctnCommand).Assembly));

// Configure Database
builder.Services.AddDbContext<EctnDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Configure Authentication (Symmetric Key matches Phase 02 for dev, Vault for prod)
var secretKey = builder.Configuration["Jwt:Secret"] ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT Secret is missing from production configuration.");
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
            IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secretKey)),
            ValidateIssuer = false,
            ValidateAudience = false,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

// Configure Permission-Based Authorization
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.submit", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.submit"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.approve", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.approve"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.issue", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.issue"));
});

var app = builder.Build();

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Application/Commands/CreateEctnCommand.cs">
using System;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Application.Commands;

public class CreateEctnCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; set; }
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
}

public class CreateEctnCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEctnCommand, Guid>
{
    // Normally injected via DI: IEctnRepository, IUnitOfWork
    
    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateEctnCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Validate (FluentValidation would intercept before this point)
        
        // 2. Map command to Domain Entity
        var ectn = new Domain.Entities.Ectn(
            request.TenantId,
            request.ApplicationReference,
            request.Type,
            request.CreatedBy
        );

        // 3. Save via Repository
        // await _repository.AddAsync(ectn, cancellationToken);
        // await _unitOfWork.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

        // 4. Return the new ID
        return ectn.Id;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Application/Commands/CreateEctnCommandValidator.cs">
using FluentValidation;

namespace Ectn.Application.Commands;

public class CreateEctnCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEctnCommand>
{
    public CreateEctnCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty().WithMessage("TenantId is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.ApplicationReference).NotEmpty().MaximumLength(100);
        RuleFor(x => x.Type).IsInEnum();
        RuleFor(x => x.CreatedBy).NotEmpty();
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Entities/Ectn.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Entities;

public class Ectn
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string EctnNumber { get; private set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; private set; }
    public EctnStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime? IssueDate { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ExpiryDate { get; private set; }

    public string PortOfLoading { get; private set; }
    public string PortOfDischarge { get; private set; }
    public string FinalDestination { get; private set; }
    public string CountryOfOrigin { get; private set; }
    public string CountryOfDestination { get; private set; }

    public string VesselReference { get; private set; }
    public string VoyageReference { get; private set; }

    public Guid? ImporterPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ExporterPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ConsigneePartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? NotifyPartyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? FreightForwarderPartyId { get; private set; }

    public int TotalPackages { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalGrossWeight { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalNetWeight { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalVolume { get; private set; }

    public string Currency { get; private set; }
    public decimal TotalDeclaredValue { get; private set; }

    public string Purpose { get; private set; }
    public string Remarks { get; private set; }

    public DateTime? SubmittedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ReviewedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ApprovedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? RejectedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? IssuedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? CancelledAt { get; private set; }

    public Guid CreatedBy { get; private set; }
    public Guid? UpdatedBy { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }

    public byte[] RowVersion { get; private set; }

    // Navigation properties for EF Core
    private readonly List<EctnParty> _parties = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<EctnParty> Parties => _parties.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<CargoShipment> _cargoShipments = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<CargoShipment> CargoShipments => _cargoShipments.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<BillOfLading> _billOfLadings = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<BillOfLading> BillOfLadings => _billOfLadings.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<Container> _containers = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<Container> Containers => _containers.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<EctnDocument> _documents = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<EctnDocument> Documents => _documents.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<EctnStatusHistory> _statusHistories = new();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<EctnStatusHistory> StatusHistories => _statusHistories.AsReadOnly();

    protected Ectn() { }

    public Ectn(Guid tenantId, string applicationReference, EctnType type, Guid createdBy)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        ApplicationReference = applicationReference;
        Type = type;
        Status = EctnStatus.Draft;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void UpdateStatus(EctnStatus newStatus, Guid actorId, string reason = null)
    {
        Status = newStatus;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = actorId;

        _statusHistories.Add(new EctnStatusHistory(Id, TenantId, newStatus, actorId, reason));
    }

    public void Submit(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only draft ECTNs can be submitted.");
        
        UpdateStatus(EctnStatus.Submitted, actorId);
        SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Approve(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview && Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only submitted or under review ECTNs can be approved.");
        
        UpdateStatus(EctnStatus.Approved, actorId);
        ApprovedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Issue(string ectnNumber, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only approved ECTNs can be issued.");
        
        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
        IssueDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        ExpiryDate = IssueDate.Value.AddMonths(6); // Configurable in policy ideally
        UpdateStatus(EctnStatus.Issued, actorId);
        IssuedAt = IssueDate;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Services/EctnStateTransitionService.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Services;

public interface IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId);
}

public class EctnStateTransitionService : IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    public Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId)
    {
        // Enforce strict Domain Invariants (Rule 83)
        switch (targetStatus)
        {
            case EctnStatus.Submitted:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be in Draft state to be submitted.");
                if (ectn.Parties.Count == 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have at least one party defined before submission.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Approved:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview && ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Issued:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Approved before it can be Issued.");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectn.EctnNumber))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have an official number assigned before issuance.");
                break;

            case EctnStatus.Rejected:
                if (ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Issued || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Expired || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
                break;
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Persistence/EctnDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class EctnDbContext : DbContext
{
    public EctnDbContext(DbContextOptions<EctnDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<Domain.Entities.Ectn> Ectns { get; set; }
    public DbSet<EctnParty> EctnParties { get; set; }
    public DbSet<CargoShipment> CargoShipments { get; set; }
    public DbSet<BillOfLading> BillOfLadings { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Container> Containers { get; set; }
    public DbSet<EctnDocument> EctnDocuments { get; set; }
    public DbSet<EctnStatusHistory> EctnStatusHistories { get; set; }
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // Aggregate Root configuration
        modelBuilder.Entity<Domain.Entities.Ectn>(builder =>
        {
            builder.ToTable("Ectns");
            builder.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            
            // Unique composite index for strict isolation
            builder.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.EctnNumber }).IsUnique();
            builder.HasIndex(e => e.ApplicationReference);

            // Optimistic concurrency
            builder.Property(e => e.RowVersion).IsRowVersion();

            // Status as string conversion
            builder.Property(e => e.Status)
                   .HasConversion(
                       v => v.ToString(),
                       v => (EctnStatus)System.Enum.Parse(typeof(EctnStatus), v));

            // Type as string conversion
            builder.Property(e => e.Type)
                   .HasConversion(
                       v => v.ToString(),
                       v => (EctnType)System.Enum.Parse(typeof(EctnType), v));

            // Tenant global query filter
            builder.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<Guid>(e, "TenantId") == CurrentTenantId);
            
            // Map navigations to private collections via fields
            builder.HasMany(e => e.Parties)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(p => p.EctnId);
                   
            builder.HasMany(e => e.CargoShipments)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnId);

            builder.HasMany(e => e.BillOfLadings)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(b => b.EctnId);

            builder.HasMany(e => e.Containers)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnId);

            builder.HasMany(e => e.Documents)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(d => d.EctnId);

            builder.HasMany(e => e.StatusHistories)
                   .WithOne()
                   .HasForeignKey(s => s.EctnId);
        });

        // Other entity mappings
        modelBuilder.Entity<EctnParty>().HasKey(p => p.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<CargoShipment>().HasKey(c => c.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<BillOfLading>().HasKey(b => b.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<Container>().HasKey(c => c.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<EctnDocument>().HasKey(d => d.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<EctnStatusHistory>().HasKey(s => s.Id);
        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>().HasKey(o => o.Id);
    }

    // Context for TenantId filtering; normally injected via ICurrentTenantService
    public Guid CurrentTenantId { get; set; }
}
</file>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Services/EctnNumberGenerator.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Ectn.Application.Interfaces;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnNumberGenerator : IEctnNumberGenerator
{
    private readonly EctnDbContext _dbContext;

    public EctnNumberGenerator(EctnDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<string> GenerateOfficialNumberAsync(Guid tenantId, string portOfLoading, DateTime issueDate)
    {
        // Enterprise ECTN number generation: ECTN-{YEAR}-{PORT}-{SEQUENCE}
        // Utilizing a database sequence for strict transaction-safe collision prevention
        var year = issueDate.Year;
        var portCode = portOfLoading?.Substring(0, Math.Min(3, portOfLoading.Length)).ToUpperInvariant() ?? "GEN";
        
        long sequenceValue;
        using (var command = _dbContext.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand())
        {
            command.CommandText = $"SELECT nextval('ectn_seq_{tenantId:N}')";
            _dbContext.Database.OpenConnection();
            var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
            sequenceValue = result != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt64(result) : throw new Exception("Sequence generation failed");
        }

        return $"ECTN-{year}-{portCode}-{sequenceValue}";
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Dockerfile">
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS base
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 80
EXPOSE 443

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Api/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Application/Ectn.Application.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Application/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Ectn.Domain.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Ectn.Infrastructure.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/"]
COPY ["services/ectn/Ectn.Contracts/Ectn.Contracts.csproj", "services/ectn/Ectn.Contracts/"]
RUN dotnet restore "services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj"

COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/services/ectn/Ectn.Api"
RUN dotnet build "Ectn.Api.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "Ectn.Api.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false

FROM base AS final
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
# Run as non-root user for security
RUN adduser --disabled-password --gecos "" appuser && chown -R appuser /app
USER appuser
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Ectn.Api.dll"]

        stage('Checkout') {

            steps {
                sh 'dotnet restore services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj'
                sh 'dotnet build services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Ectn.Api.csproj -c Release --no-restore'
            }

        stage('Unit & Architecture Tests') {
            steps {
                sh 'dotnet test tests/Ectn.UnitTests/Ectn.UnitTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --logger "trx;LogFileName=test_results.trx" /p:CollectCoverage=true /p:CoverletOutputFormat=cobertura'
            }
        }

        stage('Security & Secret Scan') {
            steps {
                sh 'trivy fs --exit-code 1 --severity CRITICAL,HIGH .'
                // sh 'gitleaks detect -v'
            }
        }

        stage('Container Build & Push') {
            steps {
                script {
                    docker.build("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}", "-f services/ectn/Dockerfile .")
                    docker.withRegistry("https://${REGISTRY}", 'registry-credentials-id') {
                        docker.image("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}").push()
                        docker.image("${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}").push("latest")
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Update ArgoCD Manifests') {
            steps {
                // Update the image tag in the deployment yaml
                sh "sed -i 's|image: ${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:.*|image: ${REGISTRY}/${DOCKER_IMAGE}:${env.BUILD_ID}|g' infrastructure/k8s/ectn-api-deployment.yaml"
                // Commit and push back to git repo to trigger ArgoCD synchronization
            }
        }
    }
    
    post {
        always {
            junit 'tests/**/TestResults/*.trx'
        }
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Api/Controllers/DispatchesController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Fleet.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/dispatches")]
[Authorize]
public class DispatchesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public DispatchesController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateDispatch([FromBody] CreateDispatchCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var dispatchId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetDispatch), new { id = dispatchId }, new { DispatchId = dispatchId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDispatch(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Draft" });
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Application/Commands/CreateDispatchCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Fleet.Application.Commands;

public class CreateDispatchCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid FleetCompanyId { get; set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; set; }
    public Guid DriverId { get; set; }
    public string CargoReference { get; set; }
    public string CustomsCaseReference { get; set; }
}

public class CreateDispatchCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateDispatchCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly FleetDbContext _context;

    public CreateDispatchCommandHandler(FleetDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateDispatchCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var dispatchNumber = $"DSP-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var dispatch = new DispatchOrder(
            request.TenantId,
            dispatchNumber,
            request.FleetCompanyId,
            request.VehicleId,
            request.DriverId,
            request.CargoReference,
            request.CustomsCaseReference
        );

        _context.DispatchOrders.Add(dispatch);
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return dispatch.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Domain/Entities/DispatchOrder.cs">
using System;
using Fleet.Domain.Enums;

namespace Fleet.Domain.Entities;

public class DispatchOrder
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string DispatchNumber { get; private set; }
    public Guid FleetCompanyId { get; private set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? TrailerId { get; private set; }
    public Guid DriverId { get; private set; }
    
    // External References
    public string CargoReference { get; private set; }
    public string DeclarationReference { get; private set; }
    public string ECTNReference { get; private set; }
    public string CustomsCaseReference { get; private set; }
    
    public string Destination { get; private set; }
    public string Origin { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? PlannedDeparture { get; private set; }
    
    public DispatchStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ComplianceSnapshotId { get; private set; }
    public string Notes { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected DispatchOrder() { }

    public DispatchOrder(
        Guid tenantId,
        string dispatchNumber,
        Guid fleetCompanyId,
        Guid vehicleId,
        Guid driverId,
        string cargoReference,
        string customsCaseReference)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        DispatchNumber = dispatchNumber;
        FleetCompanyId = fleetCompanyId;
        VehicleId = vehicleId;
        DriverId = driverId;
        CargoReference = cargoReference;
        CustomsCaseReference = customsCaseReference;
        Status = DispatchStatus.Draft;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Approve(Guid complianceSnapshotId)
    {
        if (Status != DispatchStatus.Ready)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Dispatch must be in Ready state before approval.");
        }

        Status = DispatchStatus.Approved;
        ComplianceSnapshotId = complianceSnapshotId;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Domain/Entities/Vehicle.cs">
using System;
using Fleet.Domain.Enums;

namespace Fleet.Domain.Entities;

public class Vehicle
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid FleetCompanyId { get; private set; }
    public string VehicleType { get; private set; }
    public string RegistrationPlate { get; private set; }
    public string VIN { get; private set; }
    public string ChassisNumber { get; private set; }
    public string EngineNumber { get; private set; }
    public string Make { get; private set; }
    public string Model { get; private set; }
    public int ModelYear { get; private set; }
    public string Color { get; private set; }
    public string CountryOfRegistration { get; private set; }
    public string FuelType { get; private set; }
    public decimal GrossVehicleWeight { get; private set; }
    public decimal TareWeight { get; private set; }
    public decimal Capacity { get; private set; }
    
    public VehicleStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public ComplianceStatus ComplianceStatus { get; private set; }
    
    public Guid? CurrentDriverId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? CurrentTrailerId { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Vehicle() { }

    public Vehicle(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid fleetCompanyId,
        string vehicleType,
        string registrationPlate,
        string vin,
        string make,
        string model,
        int modelYear)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        FleetCompanyId = fleetCompanyId;
        VehicleType = vehicleType;
        RegistrationPlate = registrationPlate;
        VIN = vin;
        Make = make;
        Model = model;
        ModelYear = modelYear;
        Status = VehicleStatus.Draft;
        ComplianceStatus = ComplianceStatus.Pending; // Or Warning depending on initial checks
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void AssignDriverAndTrailer(Guid driverId, Guid? trailerId)
    {
        if (Status == VehicleStatus.Retired || Status == VehicleStatus.Held)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign driver to a vehicle that is retired or held.");
        }

        CurrentDriverId = driverId;
        CurrentTrailerId = trailerId;
        Status = VehicleStatus.Assigned;
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Infrastructure/Persistence/FleetDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;

namespace Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class FleetDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<Vehicle> Vehicles { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Driver> Drivers { get; set; }
    public DbSet<DispatchOrder> DispatchOrders { get; set; }

    public FleetDbContext(DbContextOptions<FleetDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Vehicle>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.RegistrationPlate }).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.VIN).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.GrossVehicleWeight).HasColumnType("decimal(10,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.TareWeight).HasColumnType("decimal(10,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Capacity).HasColumnType("decimal(10,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Driver>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.DriverNumber }).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DispatchOrder>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.DispatchNumber }).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Api/Controllers/TelemetryIngestionController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace GpsTelematics.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/gps/ingest")]
public class TelemetryIngestionController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public TelemetryIngestionController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    // Note: In production, this would use a specialized scheme for Device Token / Client Certificate auth
    // rather than standard user JWTs. We simulate standard auth here for demonstration.
    [Authorize] 
    public async Task<IActionResult> IngestTelemetry([FromBody] IngestTelemetryCommand command)
    {
        // For security, TenantId and DeviceId should be extracted from the authenticated device token
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }
        
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "deviceId"))
        {
            command.DeviceId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("deviceId").Value);
        }

        var positionId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Accepted(new { PositionId = positionId, Status = "Processed" });
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Application/Commands/IngestTelemetryCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;

public class IngestTelemetryCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid DeviceId { get; set; }
    public double Latitude { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }
    public double Speed { get; set; }
    public double Heading { get; set; }
    public DateTime RecordedAt { get; set; }
    public long SequenceNumber { get; set; }
    // VehicleId is resolved during processing if device is actively assigned
    public Guid? VehicleId { get; set; } 
}

public class IngestTelemetryCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<IngestTelemetryCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly GpsDbContext _context;

    public IngestTelemetryCommandHandler(GpsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(IngestTelemetryCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var position = new GpsPosition(
            request.TenantId,
            request.DeviceId,
            request.VehicleId,
            request.Latitude,
            request.Longitude,
            request.Speed,
            request.Heading,
            request.RecordedAt,
            request.SequenceNumber
        );

        _context.Positions.Add(position);
        
        // Logic to update LatestLocationCache (Redis) would go here
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return position.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Domain/Entities/Geofence.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Enums;

namespace GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

public class Geofence
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public GeofenceType Type { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS Geometry for Polygon/Circle
    public Geometry Boundary { get; private set; }
    
    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public string EnterAction { get; private set; }
    public string ExitAction { get; private set; }
    public double? SpeedLimit { get; private set; }
    public int? DwellThresholdSeconds { get; private set; }
    
    public string CreatedBy { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    protected Geofence() { }

    public Geofence(
        Guid tenantId,
        string name,
        GeofenceType type,
        Geometry boundary)
    {
        if (boundary == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(boundary));
        
        // Ensure SRID is set
        if (boundary.SRID == 0) boundary.SRID = 4326;

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        Name = name;
        Type = type;
        Boundary = boundary;
        Active = true;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public bool Contains(Point point)
    {
        return Boundary.Contains(point);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Domain/Entities/GpsPosition.cs">
using System;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;

namespace GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

public class GpsPosition
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid DeviceId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? VehicleId { get; private set; }
    
    // PostGIS Geometry Point
    public Point Location { get; private set; }
    
    public double Altitude { get; private set; }
    public double Speed { get; private set; }
    public double Heading { get; private set; }
    public double Accuracy { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime RecordedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime ReceivedAt { get; private set; }
    
    public bool? Ignition { get; private set; }
    public double? Odometer { get; private set; }
    
    public string Source { get; private set; }
    public long SequenceNumber { get; private set; }
    public string CorrelationId { get; private set; }

    protected GpsPosition() { }

    public GpsPosition(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid deviceId,
        Guid? vehicleId,
        double latitude,
        double longitude,
        double speed,
        double heading,
        DateTime recordedAt,
        long sequenceNumber)
    {
        // Simple coordinate validation
        if (latitude < -90 || latitude > 90) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(latitude));
        if (longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(longitude));

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        DeviceId = deviceId;
        VehicleId = vehicleId;
        
        // Create NTS Point (SRID 4326 is standard for GPS - WGS 84)
        Location = new Point(longitude, latitude) { SRID = 4326 };
        
        Speed = speed;
        Heading = heading;
        RecordedAt = recordedAt;
        ReceivedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Infrastructure/Persistence/GpsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

namespace GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class GpsDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<GpsDevice> Devices { get; set; }
    public DbSet<GpsPosition> Positions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Geofence> Geofences { get; set; }

    public GpsDbContext(DbContextOptions<GpsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // PostGIS integration requires setting up the extension in migrations, 
        // which Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL.NetTopologySuite handles.
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsDevice>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.DeviceIdentifier }).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsPosition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            // Index for fast geospatial querying
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
            // Composite index for time-series querying
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.TenantId, e.DeviceId, e.RecordedAt });
            
            // Map the NTS Point to PostGIS geometry(Point, 4326)
            entity.Property(e => e.Location).HasColumnType("geometry(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Geofence>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            
            // Spatial index for geofences
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Boundary).HasMethod("GIST");
            entity.Property(e => e.Boundary).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;

namespace Identity.Api.Middleware;

public class TenantResolutionMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

    public TenantResolutionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next)
    {
        _next = next;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context, ITenantContext tenantContext)
    {
        // Example: Resolve tenant from header or JWT Claims
        if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Tenant-Code", out var tenantCodeHeader))
        {
            var code = tenantCodeHeader.FirstOrDefault();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            {
                // In a real implementation, you would validate this code exists
                // and assign it to the scoped ITenantContext.
                // tenantContext.SetTenant(code);
            }
        }
        else if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            // Extract from JWT "tenant_id" claim
            var tenantClaim = context.User.FindFirst("tenant_id");
            if (tenantClaim != null)
            {
                // tenantContext.SetTenant(Guid.Parse(tenantClaim.Value));
            }
        }

        // Call the next delegate/middleware in the pipeline
        await _next(context);
    }
}
