<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Persistence/IdentityDbContext.cs">
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IdentityDbContext : DbContext
{
    public IdentityDbContext(DbContextOptions<IdentityDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Tenant> Tenants => Set<Tenant>();
    public DbSet<Organization> Organizations => Set<Organization>();
    public DbSet<Role> Roles => Set<Role>();
    public DbSet<Permission> Permissions => Set<Permission>();
    public DbSet<UserRole> UserRoles => Set<UserRole>();
    public DbSet<RolePermission> RolePermissions => Set<RolePermission>();
    public DbSet<Session> Sessions => Set<Session>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Tenant boundaries and unique constraints
        builder.Entity<Tenant>()
            .HasIndex(t => t.Code)
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<User>()
            .HasIndex(u => new { u.NormalizedEmail, u.TenantId })
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<Organization>()
            .HasIndex(o => new { o.Code, o.TenantId })
            .IsUnique();

        builder.Entity<Role>()
            .HasIndex(r => new { r.Code, r.TenantId })
            .IsUnique();

        // Many-to-Many Relationships
        builder.Entity<UserRole>()
            .HasKey(ur => new { ur.UserId, ur.RoleId });

        builder.Entity<RolePermission>()
            .HasKey(rp => new { rp.RoleId, rp.PermissionId });
            
        // Concurrency token for User to prevent lost updates
        builder.Entity<User>()
            .Property(u => u.RowVersion)
            .IsRowVersion();
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/Argon2PasswordHasher.cs">
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class Argon2PasswordHasher : IPasswordHasher
{
    // In a real .NET 8+ app, you might use BCrypt.Net-Next or a native Argon2 library.
    // This is a placeholder using PBKDF2 to demonstrate the interface implementation.
    
    public string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        byte[] salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(128 / 8); 

        string hashed = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: password,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 100000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

        return $"{Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}.{hashed}";
    }

    public bool VerifyPassword(string password, string hash)
    {
        var parts = hash.Split('.', 2);
        if (parts.Length != 2) return false;

        var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[0]);
        var expectedHash = parts[1];

        string actualHash = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: password,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 100000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

        return expectedHash == actualHash;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/JwtTokenGenerator.cs">
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class JwtTokenGenerator : IJwtTokenGenerator
{
    private readonly string _secretKey = "SUPER_SECRET_KEY_THAT_SHOULD_BE_IN_VAULT_NOT_HERE";
    private readonly string _issuer = "SmartTradePlatform";
    private readonly string _audience = "SmartTradeServices";

    public string GenerateAccessToken(User user, Tenant tenant, IEnumerable<string> permissions)
    {
        var securityKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_secretKey));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(securityKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim("tenant_id", tenant.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim("tenant_code", tenant.Code)
        };

        if (user.OrganizationId.HasValue)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("organization_id", user.OrganizationId.Value.ToString()));
        }

        foreach (var permission in permissions)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("permissions", permission));
        }

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: _issuer,
            audience: _audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15), // Short-lived
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
    }

    public string GenerateRefreshToken()
    {
        var randomNumber = new byte[32];
        using var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(randomNumber);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(randomNumber);
    }

    public string HashToken(string token)
    {
        using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
        var hashedBytes = sha256.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token));
        return Convert.ToBase64String(hashedBytes);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Controllers/WebhooksController.cs">
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Integration.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Integration.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/integration/webhooks")]
// Webhooks often use custom auth (like HMAC signatures on the payload), so standard JWT Authorize might be bypassed here in favor of middleware/ActionFilters
[AllowAnonymous] 
public class WebhooksController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public WebhooksController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("{partnerCode}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ReceiveWebhook(string partnerCode)
    {
        // Extract raw body for signature validation
        using var reader = new StreamReader(Request.Body, Encoding.UTF8);
        var payload = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
        
        // Extract headers
        var signature = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].ToString();
        var timestampHeader = Request.Headers["X-Timestamp"].ToString();
        
        DateTime? timestamp = null;
        if (long.TryParse(timestampHeader, out var ts))
        {
            timestamp = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(ts).UtcDateTime;
        }

        var command = new ProcessWebhookCommand
        {
            // Usually derived from the URL or specific headers for webhooks
            TenantId = Guid.Empty, // Would be resolved via PartnerCode mapping in the command handler
            PartnerCode = partnerCode,
            Payload = payload,
            Signature = signature,
            Timestamp = timestamp
        };

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);

        if (result)
        {
            // Always return fast HTTP 202 to the external partner to prevent timeout retries
            return Accepted(new { Status = "Received", Message = "Webhook payload accepted for asynchronous processing." });
        }
        
        return BadRequest(new { Error = "Invalid webhook payload or signature." });
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Application/Commands/ProcessWebhookCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;
using Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Integration.Application.Commands;

public class ProcessWebhookCommand : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string PartnerCode { get; set; }
    public string Payload { get; set; }
    public string Signature { get; set; }
    public DateTime? Timestamp { get; set; }
}

public class ProcessWebhookCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ProcessWebhookCommand, bool>
{
    private readonly IntegrationDbContext _context;
    
    // In a real application, we'd inject IExternalRequestSigner to verify the HMAC

    public ProcessWebhookCommandHandler(IntegrationDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(ProcessWebhookCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Fetch Partner and WebhookEndpoint (for secret references)
        // 2. Validate Signature against payload
        // 3. Check for replay/idempotency against Redis
        // 4. Save to InboxMessage table for reliable asynchronous processing (outbox pattern backwards)
        
        // Simulating Inbox insertion
        
        return await Task.FromResult(true); // Webhook accepted successfully.
    }
}

public class ExternalSystemReference

    public string InternalEntityId { get; private set; } // Our internal ID
    
    public string ExternalReference { get; private set; } // E.g., The human readable code
    public string MappingStatus { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime FirstSeenAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime LastSeenAt { get; private set; }
    public string Version { get; private set; }

    protected ExternalSystemReference() { }

    public ExternalSystemReference(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid integrationId,
        string externalSystem,
        string externalEntityType,
        string externalEntityId,
        string internalEntityType,
        string internalEntityId,
        string externalReference)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        IntegrationId = integrationId;
        ExternalSystem = externalSystem;
        ExternalEntityType = externalEntityType;
        ExternalEntityId = externalEntityId;
        InternalEntityType = internalEntityType;
        InternalEntityId = internalEntityId;
        ExternalReference = externalReference;
        MappingStatus = "Mapped";
        FirstSeenAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        LastSeenAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

    public string TimestampHeader { get; private set; }

    public bool Active { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }

    protected WebhookEndpoint() { }

    public WebhookEndpoint(Guid tenantId, Guid integrationId, string path, string signatureHeader, string expectedSecretReference)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        IntegrationId = integrationId;
        Path = path;
        SignatureHeader = signatureHeader;
        ExpectedSecretReference = expectedSecretReference;
        RequiresTimestamp = true;
        MaxTimestampDriftSeconds = 300; // 5 mins
        Active = true;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Infrastructure/Persistence/IntegrationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IntegrationDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<Partner> Partners { get; set; }
    public DbSet<IntegrationDefinition> IntegrationDefinitions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<WebhookEndpoint> WebhookEndpoints { get; set; }
    public DbSet<ExternalSystemReference> ExternalSystemReferences { get; set; }

    public IntegrationDbContext(DbContextOptions<IntegrationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Partner>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.PartnerCode).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationDefinition>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Code).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<WebhookEndpoint>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Path).IsUnique(); // e.g., only one partner per unique webhook path
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<ExternalSystemReference>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            // Composite index on external identifier to allow fast lookups mapping to internal entities
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.ExternalSystem, e.ExternalEntityType, e.ExternalEntityId }).IsUnique();
        });
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Infrastructure/Integration.Infrastructure.csproj">
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Api/Controllers/PaymentIntentsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Payment.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/intents")]
[Authorize]
public class PaymentIntentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public PaymentIntentsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateIntent([FromBody] CreatePaymentIntentCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var intentId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetIntent), new { id = intentId }, new { IntentId = intentId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetIntent(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Pending" });
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Application/Commands/CreatePaymentIntentCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;
using Payment.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Payment.Application.Commands;

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ExternalReference { get; set; }
    public string SourceSystem { get; set; }
    public string SourceAggregateId { get; set; }
    public Guid CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; }
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; }
    public decimal Amount { get; set; }
    public string Currency { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
}

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreatePaymentIntentCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly PaymentDbContext _context;

    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler(PaymentDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreatePaymentIntentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var paymentReference = $"PAY-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var money = new Money(request.Amount, request.Currency);

        var intent = new PaymentIntent(
            request.TenantId,
            paymentReference,
            request.SourceSystem,
            request.SourceAggregateId,
            request.CustomsCaseId,
            request.DeclarationNumber,
            request.ECTNNumber,
            money,
            request.DueDate
        );

        _context.PaymentIntents.Add(intent);
        
        // Idempotency check and Outbox event logic would go here
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return intent.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/LedgerEntry.cs">
using System;

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class LedgerEntry
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string TransactionReference { get; private set; }
    public string Account { get; private set; }
    public decimal Debit { get; private set; }
    public decimal Credit { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }
    public string Source { get; private set; }
    public string SourceReference { get; private set; }
    public DateTime PostedAt { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public string CorrelationId { get; private set; }

    protected LedgerEntry() { }

    public LedgerEntry(
        Guid tenantId,
        string transactionReference,
        string account,
        decimal debit,
        decimal credit,
        string currency,
        string source,
        string sourceReference,
        string description,
        string correlationId)
    {
        if (debit < 0 || credit < 0) throw new ArgumentException("Debit and Credit must be positive");
        if (debit > 0 && credit > 0) throw new ArgumentException("Cannot have both Debit and Credit in the same entry");

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        TransactionReference = transactionReference;
        Account = account;
        Debit = debit;
        Credit = credit;
        Currency = currency;
        Source = source;
        SourceReference = sourceReference;
        Description = description;
        CorrelationId = correlationId;
        PostedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/PaymentIntent.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Payment.Domain.Enums;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class PaymentIntent
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string PaymentReference { get; private set; }
    public string ExternalReference { get; private set; }
    public string SourceSystem { get; private set; }
    public string SourceAggregateId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CustomsCaseId { get; private set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; private set; }
    public string ECTNNumber { get; private set; }
    public string PayerId { get; private set; }
    public string PayerOrganizationId { get; private set; }
    
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }
    
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; private set; }
    public PaymentIntentStatus Status { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; private set; }
    public byte[] Version { get; private set; }

    private readonly List<PaymentBreakdown> _breakdowns = new List<PaymentBreakdown>();
    public IReadOnlyCollection<PaymentBreakdown> Breakdowns => _breakdowns.AsReadOnly();

    protected PaymentIntent() { }

    public PaymentIntent(
        Guid tenantId,
        string paymentReference,
        string sourceSystem,
        string sourceAggregateId,
        Guid customsCaseId,
        string declarationNumber,
        string ectnNumber,
        Money amountToPay,
        DateTime? dueDate = null)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        PaymentReference = paymentReference;
        SourceSystem = sourceSystem;
        SourceAggregateId = sourceAggregateId;
        CustomsCaseId = customsCaseId;
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber;
        ECTNNumber = ectnNumber;
        Amount = amountToPay.Amount;
        Currency = amountToPay.Currency;
        DueDate = dueDate;
        Status = PaymentIntentStatus.Created;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void AddBreakdown(PaymentBreakdown breakdown)
    {
        _breakdowns.Add(breakdown);
    }
}

public class PaymentBreakdown
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid PaymentIntentId { get; private set; }
    public string Type { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public string SourceReference { get; private set; }
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }
    public string LegalBasis { get; private set; }

    protected PaymentBreakdown() { }

    public PaymentBreakdown(string type, string description, string sourceReference, decimal amount, string currency, string legalBasis)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        Type = type;
        Description = description;
        SourceReference = sourceReference;
        Amount = amount;
        Currency = currency;
        LegalBasis = legalBasis;
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/PaymentTransaction.cs">
using System;
using Payment.Domain.Enums;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class PaymentTransaction
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public Guid PaymentIntentId { get; private set; }
    
    public string TransactionReference { get; private set; }
    public string ProviderReference { get; private set; }
    
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }
    
    public string PaymentMethod { get; private set; }
    public string Provider { get; private set; }
    
    public PaymentTransactionStatus Status { get; private set; }
    
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? FailedAt { get; private set; }
    public string FailureReason { get; private set; }
    public string CorrelationId { get; private set; }

    protected PaymentTransaction() { }

    public PaymentTransaction(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid paymentIntentId,
        string transactionReference,
        Money amount,
        string paymentMethod,
        string provider,
        string correlationId)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        TenantId = tenantId;
        PaymentIntentId = paymentIntentId;
        TransactionReference = transactionReference;
        Amount = amount.Amount;
        Currency = amount.Currency;
        PaymentMethod = paymentMethod;
        Provider = provider;
        CorrelationId = correlationId;
        Status = PaymentTransactionStatus.Initiated;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Confirm(string providerReference)
    {
        Status = PaymentTransactionStatus.Succeeded;
        ProviderReference = providerReference;
        CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Fail(string reason)
    {
        Status = PaymentTransactionStatus.Failed;
        FailureReason = reason;
        FailedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/ValueObjects/Money.cs">
using System;

namespace Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

public class Money : IEquatable<Money>
{
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }

    protected Money() { }

    public Money(decimal amount, string currency)
    {
        if (amount < 0) throw new ArgumentException("Amount cannot be negative", nameof(amount));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currency)) throw new ArgumentException("Currency must be specified", nameof(currency));

        Amount = Math.Round(amount, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero); // Default rounding policy for now
        Currency = currency.ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    public static Money Zero(string currency) => new Money(0, currency);

    public Money Add(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add different currencies");
        return new Money(Amount + other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public Money Subtract(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract different currencies");
        if (Amount < other.Amount)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract to a negative amount");
        return new Money(Amount - other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public bool Equals(Money other)
    {
        if (other is null) return false;
        return Amount == other.Amount && Currency == other.Currency;
    }

    public override bool Equals(object obj) => Equals(obj as Money);

    public override int GetHashCode() => HashCode.Combine(Amount, Currency);
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Infrastructure/Persistence/PaymentDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Threading;

namespace Payment.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class PaymentDbContext : DbContext
{
    public DbSet<PaymentIntent> PaymentIntents { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PaymentBreakdown> PaymentBreakdowns { get; set; }
    public DbSet<PaymentTransaction> PaymentTransactions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<LedgerEntry> LedgerEntries { get; set; }

    public PaymentDbContext(DbContextOptions<PaymentDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<PaymentIntent>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.PaymentReference).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Amount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            entity.HasMany(e => e.Breakdowns)
                  .WithOne()
                  .HasForeignKey(b => b.PaymentIntentId);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<PaymentBreakdown>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Amount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<PaymentTransaction>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.TransactionReference).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Amount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<LedgerEntry>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.HasQueryFilter(e => EF.Property<System.Guid>(e, "TenantId") == e.TenantId);
            entity.Property(e => e.Debit).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
            entity.Property(e => e.Credit).HasColumnType("decimal(18,4)");
        });
    }
}

using System;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Contracts.Events;

public interface IIntegrationEvent
{
    Guid EventId { get; }
    string EventType { get; }
    int EventVersion { get; }
    DateTime OccurredAtUtc { get; }
    DateTime PublishedAtUtc { get; }
    Guid CorrelationId { get; }
    Guid? CausationId { get; }
    string TraceId { get; }
    Guid TenantId { get; }
    Guid ActorId { get; }
    string SourceService { get; }
    string AggregateType { get; }
    string AggregateId { get; }
    string SchemaVersion { get; }
}

public abstract record IntegrationEvent(
    Guid EventId,
    string EventType,
    int EventVersion,
    DateTime OccurredAtUtc,
    DateTime PublishedAtUtc,
    Guid CorrelationId,
    Guid? CausationId,
    string TraceId,
    Guid TenantId,
    Guid ActorId,
    string SourceService,
    string AggregateType,
    string AggregateId,
    string SchemaVersion
) : IIntegrationEvent;

<file path="src/building-blocks/Infrastructure/Messaging/OutboxMessage.cs">
using System;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Infrastructure.Messaging;

public enum OutboxMessageStatus
{
    Pending,
    Processing,
    Published,
    Failed,
    DeadLetter
}

public class OutboxMessage
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public string EventType { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public int EventVersion { get; private set; }
    public string AggregateId { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Payload { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime OccurredAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? PublishedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public int RetryCount { get; private set; }
    public OutboxMessageStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public string? LastError { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorrelationId { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }

    protected OutboxMessage() { } // EF Core

    public OutboxMessage(Guid id, string eventType, int eventVersion, string aggregateId, string payload, Guid correlationId, Guid tenantId)
    {
        Id = id;
        EventType = eventType;
        EventVersion = eventVersion;
        AggregateId = aggregateId;
        Payload = payload;
        OccurredAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Status = OutboxMessageStatus.Pending;
        RetryCount = 0;
        CorrelationId = correlationId;
        TenantId = tenantId;
    }
}

<file path="tests/Ectn.UnitTests/Domain/EctnAggregateTests.cs">
using System;
using Xunit;
using FluentAssertions;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.UnitTests.Domain;

public class EctnAggregateTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Submit_Should_ChangeStatusToSubmitted_When_StatusIsDraft()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = new Ectn.Domain.Entities.Ectn(tenantId, "APP-REF-123", EctnType.Standard, actorId);

        // Act
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        // Assert
        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Submitted);
        ectn.SubmittedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().ContainSingle(h => h.Status == EctnStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Submit_Should_ThrowException_When_StatusIsNotDraft()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = new Ectn.Domain.Entities.Ectn(tenantId, "APP-REF-123", EctnType.Standard, actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId); // Status is now Submitted

        // Act & Assert
        Action action = () => ectn.Submit(actorId);
        action.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
              .WithMessage("Only draft ECTNs can be submitted.");
    }
}
